items.title: 白銀多頭列車要加速！花旗喊上看90美元 潛在漲幅近4成
items.title_en: Silver Bull Train Must Accelerate! Citi Forecasts Up to $90, Potential Gain Near 40%
paras: 花旗最新重申對白銀的看多立場，預估隨著投資買盤接棒成為主要推力，銀價未來 3 個月可望升至每盎司 75 美元，未來 6 至 12 個月更可能挑戰 90 美元，較目前約 65 美元的現貨價格上漲約 38%。
花旗認為，白銀接下來的漲勢將不再主要仰賴工業用途，而是由資金流向主導。隨著荷姆茲海峽緊張局勢最終可望降溫，加上聯準會政策立場可能轉趨溫和，先前壓抑貴金屬的美元走強與實質利率上升等因素有望逐步消退，帶動白銀投資需求持續回升。
由於白銀通常與黃金同向波動，但價格彈性更高。
花旗形容，若荷姆茲海峽僵局迅速化解，白銀將成為押注貴金屬上漲的理想標的。該行基本情境預估，中東局勢最快可能在今年 9 月至 12 月間緩和，屆時白銀有望以更大幅度跟進金價上漲。
另一方面，白銀的工業需求前景開始出現結構性變化。太陽能業者持續減少單位電池的白銀用量，並加快採用背接觸式 (BC) 電池技術，可能使太陽能產業對白銀的需求成長放緩。花旗預估，BC 技術最快可於 2028 年成為太陽能市場的主流技術之一。
不過，人工智慧 (AI)、5G及電動車產業對白銀的需求仍具韌性，花旗預期全球白銀市場至少到 2027 年都將維持供不應求，為銀價提供中長期支撐。
印度市場也是另一項利多。目前印度國內銀價較國際價格溢價約 7%，反映當地買盤強勁。隨著第四季節慶及婚禮旺季到來，印度白銀需求可望進一步升溫。
paras_en: Citi reiterated its bullish stance on silver, estimating that with investment buying taking over as the main driver, the price could rise to $75 per ounce within the next three months and potentially challenge $90 within six to twelve months – about a 38% increase from the current spot price of roughly $65.

Citi believes the upcoming rally in silver will be driven less by industrial use and more by capital flows. As tensions in the Hormuz Strait are expected to ease and the Fed’s policy stance may become more dovish, the previously suppressive factors for precious metals—such as a strong dollar and rising real rates—should gradually recede, reviving investment demand for silver.
Silver typically moves in tandem with gold, but its price is more elastic.

Citi described that if the Hormuz Strait deadlock is resolved quickly, silver would become an ideal vehicle for betting on a rise in precious metals. The bank’s baseline scenario projects that the Middle‑East situation could ease as early as September to December this year, at which point silver is likely to follow gold’s gains with an even larger jump.

On the other hand, the outlook for silver’s industrial demand is beginning to shift structurally. Solar manufacturers are continuously reducing the amount of silver per cell and accelerating the adoption of back‑contact (BC) cell technology, which could slow the growth of silver demand from the solar sector. Citi estimates that BC technology could become one of the mainstream solar technologies as early as 2028.

Nevertheless, demand for silver from AI, 5G and electric‑vehicle industries remains resilient. Citi expects the global silver market to stay in deficit at least through 2027, providing medium‑ to long‑term support for prices.

India also offers a tailwind. Domestic silver prices in India carry a premium of about 7% over international levels, reflecting strong local buying. With the fourth‑quarter festive season and wedding rush approaching, Indian silver demand is expected to heat up further.

items.title: 月底生效！獲MSCI中國指數納入 智譜早盤在港股飆逾6%
items.title_en: Surge over 6%! Zhi Pian included in MSCI China Index, set to take effect on August 31
paras: 港股AI標的智谱今(13)日早盤漲逾6%至每股1297港元，因MSCI在昨日公布的成分股季度審議結果中，將包括智譜在內33檔標的納入MSCI中國指數，智谱與建滔集團為唯二新進港股，另含芯源微、風華高科、大族激光等31檔A股，同時剔除協鑫科技、金力永磁、智飛生物等32檔。上述調整將於8月31日收盤後生效。
由於MSCI中國指數被劃入MSCI新興市場指數與全球標準指數系列，入列即意味獲全球ETF與被動基金跟蹤，預計生效日尾盤將迎來海外資金集中買入。本次新興市場新增成分股市值前三為智谱、南亞科、鼎泰高科。
基本面上，大和證券日前首度給予智譜「買進」評等、目標價1500港元，認為智谱技術迭代正轉化為收入，上月年度雲端經常性收入(ARR)達10億美元，較原定目標提前五個月，集團營收有望由去年7.24億人民幣增至2029年的475億人民幣，年複合成長率185%，2029年毛利率回升至40%並轉虧為盈。
市場解讀，智谱獲納MSCI，加上MaaS商業化提速，讓港股AI基礎模型族群獲指數化配置錨點，但短期股價已反映部分預期，後續仍看token消耗、企業客戶留存與中國國產晶片適配進度。8月31日生效前，被動資金流向與北水態度將成短線觀察重點。
paras_en: Zhi Pian (HK: 1297) surged over 6% to HK$1,297 in early trading today, following MSCI's quarterly review results announced yesterday, which included Zhi Pian among 33 stocks to be added to the MSCI China Index. Zhi Pian and Build King Group are the only two new entrants from Hong Kong, while 31 A-shares, including Xingsource Micro, Windhwa High-tech, and Dahua Laser, were also included. Meanwhile, 32 stocks, including Cooperation Xin, Gold Force Permanent Magnet, and Zhifeng Bio, were removed. The adjustments will take effect after the close on August 31.

As MSCI China Index is included in the MSCI Emerging Markets Index and Global Standard Index series, being included means gaining global ETF and passive fund tracking. It is expected that overseas capital will flow in during the tail end of the trading day on the effective date. The top three stocks in terms of market value among the new additions to the emerging markets index are Zhi Pian, Nansheng Technology, and Ding Tai High-tech.

From a fundamental perspective, Daiwa Securities recently gave Zhi Pian a 'buy' rating, with a target price of HK$1,500. They believe that Zhi Pian's technology iteration is transforming into revenue. The company's annual cloud recurring revenue (ARR) reached US$1 billion in the previous month, five months ahead of the original target. The company's revenue is expected to increase from RMB 7.24 billion last year to RMB 47.5 billion in 2029, with a year-on-year compound growth rate of 185%. The gross margin is expected to rise to 40% in 2029 and turn from a loss to a profit.

Market interpretation is that Zhi Pian's inclusion in the MSCI index, combined with the acceleration of MaaS commercialization, has provided a benchmark for index allocation for the Hong Kong AI base model group. However, the stock price has already reflected part of the expectations, and the subsequent focus will be on token consumption, enterprise customer retention, and China's domestic chip adaptation progress. Before the effective date of August 31, the flow of passive funds and the attitude of northbound capital will be key short-term observations.

items.title: 星宇打造第二營運基地 台中-名古屋航線10/25開航
items.title_en: Starlux to Launch Second Hub in Taichung, Taiwan with Nagoya Flight on October 25
paras: 星宇航空(2646-TW)今(13)日宣布將於10月25日起開闢台中-名古屋航線，即日起開賣，展現將台中積極打造為第二營運基地的決心，也是繼2023年12月開航台北-名古屋後的另一條日本中部航線。
星宇表示，台中-名古屋將以新世代客機A321neo執飛，開航初期每周4班，為大台中周邊的民眾提供更便利的日本航程選擇。
星宇航空執行長翟健華說明，名古屋是日本中部最大城市，除了市區擁有豐富的歷史文化和在地美食外，還可輕鬆串聯飛驒高山、白川鄉、上高地和金澤等人氣景點。
翟健華強調，星宇持續深耕台中市場，隨著名古屋航線的加入，星宇台中航網已拓展至12個國際航點。
為迎接秋季旅遊旺季，星宇擴充區域航線運能，將於9月至10月期間針對沖繩、釜山、札幌、東京及澳門等熱門旅遊航點加開航班，其中，台中-釜山航線將於9月2日至10月24日間增班至每周8班，台中-札幌/東京航線於10月1日至10月24日增至每周7班，而台中-澳門航線則增至每周9班。
paras_en: Starlux Airlines (2646-TW) announced on August 13 that it will launch a new route from Taichung to Nagoya on October 25, with tickets available for purchase starting today. This move demonstrates the airline's commitment to developing Taichung as its second hub, following the launch of the Taipei-Nagoya route in December 2023.

The Taichung-Nagoya route will be operated by the new-generation A321neo aircraft, with four flights per week during the initial period, providing more convenient travel options for residents in the Taichung area.

Starlux Airlines CEO Lee Ching-hua explained that Nagoya is Japan's largest city in the central region, boasting a rich history and culture, as well as local cuisine. The city is also easily accessible to popular tourist destinations such as Takayama, Shirakawa-go, Kamikochi, and Kanazawa.
Lee emphasized that Starlux continues to deepen its presence in the Taichung market, with the addition of the Nagoya route expanding its Taichung network to 12 international destinations.

To coincide with the peak autumn travel season, Starlux has increased regional flight capacity, adding new flights to popular destinations such as Okinawa, Busan, Sapporo, Tokyo, and Macau from September to October. The Taichung-Busan route will see an increase in flights from four to eight per week from September 2 to October 24, while the Taichung-Sapporo/Tokyo route will see an increase to seven flights per week from October 1 to October 24. The Taichung-Macau route will see an increase to nine flights per week.

items.title: 高明鐵H1業績已超越去年全年並轉虧盈淨利1.21億元EPS達2.9元
items.title_en: High Ming Iron Exceeds Last Year's Full-Year Performance and Posts NT$1.21 Billion Net Profit
paras: 受惠 AI 資料中心建置加速、高速光通訊升級，同時高精密耦合自動化設備需求的持續升溫，由鏡頭組裝轉型的光通訊耦光工站高明鐵 (4573-TW) 1-6 月營收7.03億元已超越 2025 年全年，公司公布財報，稅後純益1.21億元，較去年轉盈，超越歷年全年獲利，每股純益達2.9元。
高明鐵 2026 年7月營收2億元創新高，2026年1-7 月營收 9.03 億元，年增 1.68 倍。
高明鐵2026年上半年財報營收7.03億元，毛利率39.35%，年增16.71個百分點，稅後純益稅後純益1.21億元，較去年轉盈，超越歷年全年獲利，每股純益達2.9元。法人預估高明鐵下半年營收及獲利大幅優於上半年，也等於是 2026 年業績將較上年倍數成長。
高明鐵在通過全球前 10 大光通訊品牌廠認證，取得 800G 及 1.6T 耦光對位產品訂單。而高明鐵也切入 CPO 封裝測試及 FAU＋MLA 精密組裝市場的龐大商機。

已加入矽光子聯盟的高明鐵，2026 年以來營運規模持續增強，在 AI 高速傳輸與光通訊設備領域的接單與出貨動能持續升溫。同時，高明鐵 4000 張現增股，以每股 325 元溢價發行，已完成募集 13 億元資金。高明鐵董事長陳志鑫指出，本次增資順利完成，代表資本市場對高明鐵轉型矽光子設備事業的肯定。高明鐵將以精密運動控制數十年累積的技術底蘊，結合 AI 對位演算法，成為 CPO 產業鏈中不可或缺的光耦合解決方案供應商。
在高明鐵的營運推展上，高明鐵已通過全球前 10 大光通訊品牌廠認證，並取得 800G 及 1.6T 光模組耦光對位模組訂單，並切入 CPO 封裝測試設備與 FAU+MLA 精密組裝，隨著客戶專案持續推進，在手訂單及營運能見度穩步增強，法人預估2026年下半年營收及獲利大幅優於上半年。
paras_en: Benefiting from the accelerated construction of AI data centers, the upgrade of high-speed optical communication, and the continuous warming of demand for high-precision coupling automation equipment, High Ming Iron (4573-TW) has exceeded last year's full-year performance with NT$1.21 billion in net profit and EPS of NT$2.9.
High Ming Iron's July revenue reached a new high of NT$2 billion, with NT$9.03 billion in revenue for the first seven months of the year, a year-over-year increase of 1.68 times.

High Ming Iron's first-half revenue was NT$703 million, with a gross margin of 39.35% and a year-over-year increase of 16.71 percentage points. The company's net profit was NT$1.21 billion, exceeding last year's full-year performance and EPS of NT$2.9.

High Ming Iron has obtained 800G and 1.6T coupling product orders from the top 10 global optical communication brands, and has entered the large market of CPO packaging testing and FAU+MLA precision assembly.

High Ming Iron, which has joined the Silicon Photonics Alliance, has seen its operating scale continue to expand since 2026, with a continuous increase in orders and shipments in the AI high-speed transmission and optical communication equipment fields. High Ming Iron has also completed the issuance of 4,000 new shares at a premium of NT$325 per share, raising NT$13 billion in capital. Chairman Chen Zhi-xin pointed out that the successful completion of this capital increase represents the capital market's affirmation of High Ming Iron's transformation into a silicon photonics equipment business.

In terms of High Ming Iron's business development, the company has obtained certification from the top 10 global optical communication brands and has secured orders for 800G and 1.6T optical module coupling modules. High Ming Iron has also entered the CPO packaging testing equipment and FAU+MLA precision assembly markets, and with the continuous progress of customer projects, the company's visibility and order backlog have continued to increase. Analysts expect High Ming Iron's revenue and profit to be significantly higher in the second half of the year than in the first half.

items.title: 量產延至2028！三星電機玻璃基板認證受挫 恢復測試至少耗時一年
items.title_en: Mass Production Delayed to 2028! Samsung Electro-Mechanics' Glass Substrate Certification Fails, Recovery Testing to Take at Least a Year
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，三星電機與日本住友化學旗下東友精細化學合資的玻璃基板公司GlaSSEM研發遇挫，送測全球主要通訊半導體廠的TGV(玻璃通孔)樣品未過可靠性認證，原定2027年下半年量產目標推遲至2028年以後，設備採購時程連續跳票數次，產線建設全面停滯。
韓媒《The Elec》近日報導指出問題出在材料與製程，樣品於高低溫循環、濕熱老化測試中出現形變、微孔導通不穩，未達AI算力晶片與CPO光模組封裝門檻。三星電機須重調玻璃配方與TGV鑽孔參數、重做樣品走完客戶全流程復測，業內估算週期至少一年以上。
TGV是下一代先進封裝兵家必爭地，台積電、英特爾、南韓SKC(Absolics)均鎖定2027年前後規模供貨，作為南韓材料龍頭的三星電機突遭延遲，直接擴大短期高端基板缺口。
與此同時，三星電機送樣認證失敗，中國京東方板級試線今年上半年全自動通線，9-2-9/20層樣品過六項信賴性測試並送測封測廠；凱盛科技8吋中試線送樣長電、通富；長信科技造孔與金屬化中試線搭載中；沃格光電1.6T CPO玻璃載板小批供貨，搭配燧原、先封CoPoS方案多輪驗證。
分析人士指出，隨著海外大廠量產延後，中國下游CPO與AI封裝廠將加速導入國產基板，從原片、激光鑽孔、鍍膜到測試配套完整，交期與成本優勢凸顯。
不過，玻璃基板認證週長、脆性與CTE控制難度高，三星踩坑亦是警鐘，中國國內廠商須把長期可靠性數據庫做厚，穩推客戶端批量認證，才抓得牢這道產能空窗期，補齊先進封裝關鍵缺口。
paras_en: According to the latest reports from foreign media, Samsung Electro-Mechanics' joint venture with Japan's Sumitomo Chemical's subsidiary, Toyo Ink SC Holdings, has encountered setbacks in developing its glass substrate company GlaSSEM. The TGV (Glass Via) samples sent to major global communication semiconductor manufacturers failed to pass reliability certification, pushing the originally planned mass production target for the second half of 2027 to 2028 or later. The equipment procurement schedule has been delayed multiple times, and the production line construction has come to a complete standstill.

A recent report by Korean media outlet The Elec states that the problem lies in the materials and processes. The samples showed deformation and unstable micro-hole conductivity during high- and low-temperature cycling and humid heat aging tests, failing to meet the requirements for AI computing power chips and CPO optical module packaging. Samsung Electro-Mechanics must re-adjust the glass formula and TGV drilling parameters, re-make the samples, and go through the entire customer process for re-testing, which is estimated to take at least a year or more.

TGV is a next-generation advanced packaging technology that is highly contested. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC), Intel, and South Korean SKC (Absolics) have all targeted 2027 for large-scale supply. As the leading materials company in South Korea, Samsung Electro-Mechanics' delay has directly expanded the short-term shortage of high-end substrates.

Meanwhile, Samsung Electro-Mechanics' sample certification failure has occurred at the same time as China's Jiangsu Hengtong's 8-inch production line has completed automatic wiring in the first half of the year, with 9-2-9/20-layer samples passing six reliability tests and being sent to the packaging and testing factory. Kaiyuan Technology's 8-inch pilot line has sent samples for long-term testing and wire bonding, while Changxin Technology's hole drilling and metalization pilot line is equipped with a 1.6T CPO glass carrier board for small-batch supply, paired with the Brillian and Xinyu CoPoS scheme for multi-round verification.

Analysts point out that as overseas major manufacturers delay mass production, Chinese downstream CPO and AI packaging factories will accelerate the introduction of domestic substrates, from wafers, laser drilling, and plating to complete testing and packaging, highlighting the advantages of shorter delivery times and lower costs.

However, the difficulty of glass substrate certification, brittleness, and CTE control is high, and Samsung's misstep also serves as a warning. Chinese domestic companies must build a long-term reliability database and stabilize customer-end batch certification to grasp this production window period and fill the key shortage in advanced packaging.

items.title: Anthropic傳砸60億美元買Decart 史上最大收購補強AI算力
items.title_en: Anthropic Spends $6 Billion to Acquire Decart in Largest Acquisition to Date
paras: 彭博引述消息人士報導，Anthropic正洽購同業 Decart AI，交易金額約達 60 億美元，若最終完成，將創下Anthropic迄今規模最大的收購紀錄，也正值其備受市場矚目的IPO前夕。
向來極少進行大型併購的 Anthropic，為了開發新產品與服務客戶，近年持續在算力上投入重金。
消息人士表示，Decart 的軟體能使晶片運作更具效率，進而降低訓練人工智慧模型的成本。這項技術有助於 Anthropic 現有基礎設施承載更龐大的需求。交易完成後，Decart 的團隊將加入 Anthropic 的推論與效能部門。
Decart 同時專注於生成式影片技術，利用所謂的「世界模型」（world models），即時修改直播影像。消息人士指出，這項技術也反映 Decart 擁有高水準的基礎設施技術人才。
Anthropic 與 Decart 的代表均拒絕置評。
Decart 今年 5 月表示，公司在由 Radical Ventures 領投的一輪融資中籌得 3 億美元，輝達(NVDA-US) 、Atreides Management、Valor Equity Partners 與 Adobe Ventures 也參與投資。既有投資人紅杉資本、Benchmark 與 Zeev Ventures 同樣參與本輪融資。
據《華爾街日報》報導，該輪融資對這家新創公司的估值逼近 40 億美元，高於 2025 年 8 月時的 31 億美元。
Decart 成立於 2023 年，由三名以色列工程師共同創辦，分別是兄弟 Dean Leitersdorf、Orian Leitersdorf，以及 Moshe Shalev。
OpenAI 與 Anthropic 都已承諾投入數百億、甚至數千億美元，興建配置昂貴晶片的資料中心。隨著運算需求急速攀升，兩家公司也愈來愈依賴不同供應商提供的硬體，以滿足龐大的算力需求。
隨著這兩家 AI 新創公司準備在未來幾個月內迎來華爾街首秀，這些被其高層認為是打造與支援尖端人工智慧模型不可或缺的龐大支出，也可能為其帶來財務壓力。
本篇不開放合作媒體轉載
paras_en: Bloomberg reported that Anthropic is in talks to acquire Decart AI, with a deal valued at around $6 billion, which would be the company's largest acquisition to date, coming at a time when it is preparing for its highly anticipated IPO.
Anthropic, which has historically been reluctant to make large acquisitions, has been investing heavily in computing power in recent years to develop new products and serve its customers.

According to sources, Decart's software enables chips to operate more efficiently, reducing the cost of training artificial intelligence models. This technology will help Anthropic's existing infrastructure handle larger demands.

Decart has also focused on generative video technology, using so-called 'world models' to modify live video in real-time. Sources say this technology reflects Decart's high level of infrastructure technology talent.
Representatives from Anthropic and Decart declined to comment.

Decart announced in May that it had raised $300 million in a funding round led by Radical Ventures, with NVIDIA (NVDA-US), Atreides Management, Valor Equity Partners, and Adobe Ventures also participating. Existing investors Redpoint Ventures, Benchmark, and Zeev Ventures also participated in the round.
According to a report by The Wall Street Journal, the funding round valued the company at around $4 billion, higher than its $3.1 billion valuation in August 2025.
Decart was founded in 2023 by three Israeli engineers, Dean Leitersdorf, Orian Leitersdorf, and Moshe Shalev.

Both OpenAI and Anthropic have committed to investing hundreds of billions, if not trillions, of dollars in building data centers equipped with expensive chips. As computing demands have skyrocketed, both companies have increasingly relied on hardware suppliers to meet their massive computing needs.

As these two AI startups prepare to go public on Wall Street in the coming months, these massive expenditures, which their executives believe are essential for building and supporting cutting-edge AI models, may also bring financial pressure.

items.title: 虛擬資產法制化 RWA代幣化掀巨浪 安永揭金融業和VASP是「海景第一排」面4大挑戰
items.title_en: Virtual Asset Legalization and RWA Tokenization Spark a Wave; EY Highlights Four Major Challenges for Finance and VASPs as the “Front‑Row Sea View”
paras: 立法院今年6月30日三讀通過「虛擬資產服務法」，象徵虛擬資產在台灣正式邁向新紀元。安永企業管理諮詢服務執行副總高旭宏指出，專法通過標誌著產業正從「技術驅動」轉向「制度驅動」，其核心價值在於建立信任。然而，專法上路僅是起點，台灣虛擬資產業未來將面臨四大「真實」挑戰，最直接受衝擊的是傳統金融與VASP (虛擬資產服務業者），需建立符合國際法遵、Travel Rule與加密資產申報框架（CARF）的全球接軌能力。
第一，從執照競賽走向差異化競賽。當業者皆提供現貨交易與基本保管時，價格戰難以形成長期優勢。市場將轉向利基型業者共榮，如專注機構保管、洗錢防制（AML/CFT）、國際轉帳規則（Travel Rule）解決方案、RWA代幣化平臺或法人服務。未來的競爭不在於規模，而在於專業價值。
第二，風險與監管挑戰。監理應落實「相同風險、相同監理」原則，讓業者將資源聚焦於核心風險。同時，面對跨境特性，VASP與金融機構須建立符合國際法遵、Travel Rule與加密資產申報框架（CARF）的全球接軌能力。
第三，銀行、券商與VASP的競合挑戰。傳統金融與虛擬資產不再是取代關係，而是「協作」。銀行可提供保管與穩定幣儲備管理，券商發展代幣化證券與數位資產顧問，VASP則扮演技術與基礎設施提供者，跨業合作能力將成為勝負關鍵。
第四，RWA代幣化的挑戰。將債券、不動產或碳權等實體資產代幣化，是市場走向實體經濟的關鍵。然而其核心挑戰在於「信任」，包括底層資產真實性、法律保障與資訊揭露等，皆需完善治理。傳統金融的嚴謹搭配區塊鏈的創新，將共同塑造下一代金融基礎設施。
高旭宏表示，傳統金融提供成熟的治理與風險管理架構；虛擬資產則帶來技術創新與效率提升的可能。兩者若能在適當監理與治理基礎下結合，將有機會共同塑造下一代金融基礎設施。因此，虛擬資產服務法的真正價值，不只是建立一套監理規範，而是為創新與信任架起橋樑，使產業擁有長期發展的基礎。
paras_en: On June 30 this year, the Legislative Yuan passed the Virtual Asset Service Act in its third reading, symbolizing that virtual assets in Taiwan are officially entering a new era. EY’s Executive Vice President of Enterprise Management Consulting, Gao Xuhong, noted that the enactment marks a shift from a “technology‑driven” to an “institution‑driven” industry, with its core value being the establishment of trust. However, the law’s rollout is only the starting point; Taiwan’s virtual‑asset sector will face four real challenges, the most immediate impact falling on traditional finance and VASPs (virtual‑asset service providers), which must build global‑compatible capabilities that meet international compliance, the Travel Rule, and the Crypto‑Asset Reporting Framework (CARF).

The first challenge is moving from a license‑driven competition to a differentiation‑driven one. When all players offer spot trading and basic custody, price wars cannot create lasting advantages. The market will shift toward niche players thriving together—those focusing on institutional custody, anti‑money‑laundering/combatting the financing of terrorism (AML/CFT), international transfer‑rule (Travel Rule) solutions, RWA tokenization platforms, or corporate services. Future competition will hinge on professional value rather than sheer scale.

The second challenge concerns risk and regulatory oversight. Supervisors should apply the “same risk, same supervision” principle, allowing firms to concentrate resources on core risks. At the same time, given the cross‑border nature of the business, VASPs and financial institutions must develop global‑compatible capabilities that satisfy international compliance, the Travel Rule, and the Crypto‑Asset Reporting Framework (CARF).

The third challenge is the competitive‑cooperative dynamics among banks, securities firms, and VASPs. Traditional finance and virtual assets are no longer in a substitution relationship but in a “collaboration” one. Banks can provide custody and stablecoin reserve management, securities firms can develop tokenized securities and digital‑asset advisory services, and VASPs act as technology and infrastructure providers. The ability to cooperate across sectors will be a decisive factor for success.

The fourth challenge involves tokenizing real‑world assets (RWA). Turning bonds, real estate, carbon credits and other tangible assets into tokens is key for the market to connect with the real economy. Yet the core hurdle is “trust,” encompassing the authenticity of underlying assets, legal protection and information disclosure, all of which require robust governance. The rigor of traditional finance combined with blockchain innovation will together shape the next‑generation financial infrastructure.

Gao Xuhong stated that traditional finance offers mature governance and risk‑management frameworks, while virtual assets bring technological innovation and efficiency gains. If the two can be combined under appropriate supervision and governance, they have the opportunity to jointly build the next‑generation financial infrastructure. Therefore, the true value of the Virtual Asset Service Act lies not merely in establishing a regulatory regime, but in bridging innovation and trust, providing the industry with a foundation for long‑term development.

items.title: 星宇打造第二營運基地 台中-名古屋航線10/25開航
items.title_en: Starlux to Launch Second Hub in Taichung, Taiwan with Nagoya Flight on October 25
paras: 星宇航空(2646-TW)今(13)日宣布將於10月25日起開闢台中-名古屋航線，即日起開賣，展現將台中積極打造為第二營運基地的決心，也是繼2023年12月開航台北-名古屋後的另一條日本中部航線。
星宇表示，台中-名古屋將以新世代客機A321neo執飛，開航初期每周4班，為大台中周邊的民眾提供更便利的日本航程選擇。
星宇航空執行長翟健華說明，名古屋是日本中部最大城市，除了市區擁有豐富的歷史文化和在地美食外，還可輕鬆串聯飛驒高山、白川鄉、上高地和金澤等人氣景點。
翟健華強調，星宇持續深耕台中市場，隨著名古屋航線的加入，星宇台中航網已拓展至12個國際航點。
為迎接秋季旅遊旺季，星宇擴充區域航線運能，將於9月至10月期間針對沖繩、釜山、札幌、東京及澳門等熱門旅遊航點加開航班，其中，台中-釜山航線將於9月2日至10月24日間增班至每周8班，台中-札幌/東京航線於10月1日至10月24日增至每周7班，而台中-澳門航線則增至每周9班。
paras_en: Starlux Airlines (2646-TW) announced on August 13 that it will launch a new route from Taichung to Nagoya on October 25, with tickets available for purchase starting today. This move demonstrates the airline's commitment to developing Taichung as its second hub, following the launch of the Taipei-Nagoya route in December 2023.

The Taichung-Nagoya route will be operated by the new-generation A321neo aircraft, with four flights per week during the initial period, providing more convenient travel options for residents in the Taichung area.

Starlux Airlines CEO Lee Ching-hua explained that Nagoya is Japan's largest city in the central region, boasting a rich history and culture, as well as local cuisine. The city is also easily accessible to popular tourist destinations such as Takayama, Shirakawa-go, Kamikochi, and Kanazawa.
Lee emphasized that Starlux continues to deepen its presence in the Taichung market, with the addition of the Nagoya route expanding its Taichung network to 12 international destinations.

To coincide with the peak autumn travel season, Starlux has increased regional flight capacity, adding new flights to popular destinations such as Okinawa, Busan, Sapporo, Tokyo, and Macau from September to October. The Taichung-Busan route will see an increase in flights from four to eight per week from September 2 to October 24, while the Taichung-Sapporo/Tokyo route will see an increase to seven flights per week from October 1 to October 24. The Taichung-Macau route will see an increase to nine flights per week.

items.title: 高明鐵H1業績已超越去年全年並轉虧盈淨利1.21億元EPS達2.9元
items.title_en: High Ming Iron Exceeds Last Year's Full-Year Performance and Posts NT$1.21 Billion Net Profit
paras: 受惠 AI 資料中心建置加速、高速光通訊升級，同時高精密耦合自動化設備需求的持續升溫，由鏡頭組裝轉型的光通訊耦光工站高明鐵 (4573-TW) 1-6 月營收7.03億元已超越 2025 年全年，公司公布財報，稅後純益1.21億元，較去年轉盈，超越歷年全年獲利，每股純益達2.9元。
高明鐵 2026 年7月營收2億元創新高，2026年1-7 月營收 9.03 億元，年增 1.68 倍。
高明鐵2026年上半年財報營收7.03億元，毛利率39.35%，年增16.71個百分點，稅後純益稅後純益1.21億元，較去年轉盈，超越歷年全年獲利，每股純益達2.9元。法人預估高明鐵下半年營收及獲利大幅優於上半年，也等於是 2026 年業績將較上年倍數成長。
高明鐵在通過全球前 10 大光通訊品牌廠認證，取得 800G 及 1.6T 耦光對位產品訂單。而高明鐵也切入 CPO 封裝測試及 FAU＋MLA 精密組裝市場的龐大商機。

已加入矽光子聯盟的高明鐵，2026 年以來營運規模持續增強，在 AI 高速傳輸與光通訊設備領域的接單與出貨動能持續升溫。同時，高明鐵 4000 張現增股，以每股 325 元溢價發行，已完成募集 13 億元資金。高明鐵董事長陳志鑫指出，本次增資順利完成，代表資本市場對高明鐵轉型矽光子設備事業的肯定。高明鐵將以精密運動控制數十年累積的技術底蘊，結合 AI 對位演算法，成為 CPO 產業鏈中不可或缺的光耦合解決方案供應商。
在高明鐵的營運推展上，高明鐵已通過全球前 10 大光通訊品牌廠認證，並取得 800G 及 1.6T 光模組耦光對位模組訂單，並切入 CPO 封裝測試設備與 FAU+MLA 精密組裝，隨著客戶專案持續推進，在手訂單及營運能見度穩步增強，法人預估2026年下半年營收及獲利大幅優於上半年。
paras_en: Benefiting from the accelerated construction of AI data centers, the upgrade of high-speed optical communication, and the continuous warming of demand for high-precision coupling automation equipment, High Ming Iron (4573-TW) has exceeded last year's full-year performance with NT$1.21 billion in net profit and EPS of NT$2.9.
High Ming Iron's July revenue reached a new high of NT$2 billion, with NT$9.03 billion in revenue for the first seven months of the year, a year-over-year increase of 1.68 times.

High Ming Iron's first-half revenue was NT$703 million, with a gross margin of 39.35% and a year-over-year increase of 16.71 percentage points. The company's net profit was NT$1.21 billion, exceeding last year's full-year performance and EPS of NT$2.9.

High Ming Iron has obtained 800G and 1.6T coupling product orders from the top 10 global optical communication brands, and has entered the large market of CPO packaging testing and FAU+MLA precision assembly.

High Ming Iron, which has joined the Silicon Photonics Alliance, has seen its operating scale continue to expand since 2026, with a continuous increase in orders and shipments in the AI high-speed transmission and optical communication equipment fields. High Ming Iron has also completed the issuance of 4,000 new shares at a premium of NT$325 per share, raising NT$13 billion in capital. Chairman Chen Zhi-xin pointed out that the successful completion of this capital increase represents the capital market's affirmation of High Ming Iron's transformation into a silicon photonics equipment business.

In terms of High Ming Iron's business development, the company has obtained certification from the top 10 global optical communication brands and has secured orders for 800G and 1.6T optical module coupling modules. High Ming Iron has also entered the CPO packaging testing equipment and FAU+MLA precision assembly markets, and with the continuous progress of customer projects, the company's visibility and order backlog have continued to increase. Analysts expect High Ming Iron's revenue and profit to be significantly higher in the second half of the year than in the first half.

Uni-President 00988A led the charge with an early morning surge of 4.06%, followed closely by Yuanta AI New Economy (00990A-TW) with a gain of over 4%, temporarily ranking second. The rest followed in order, including China Development Financial Japan Semiconductor (00954-TW) and Taiwan Shinsei Japan Semiconductor (00951-TW).

Uni-President Investment Trust's research team pointed out that the July CPI was lower than expected, with no signs of a second-round inflation, and while employment cooled, the economy did not deteriorate, making it a positive environment for risk assets. With 88% of S&P 500 companies having reported their earnings, the overall EPS exceeded expectations by 29.2%, setting a record since 2008. In terms of investment strategy, they recommended adding to the software supply chain, advanced packaging, and power management, which are accelerating the conversion of AI, and also benefiting from the slowing down of the price increase of the profit realization group.

items.title: 東森上半年獲利年增7% 將辦現增募資20億元推動三大事業
items.title_en: Eastern Broadcasting Corporation Posts 7% Increase in First-Half Net Profit, Plans to Raise NT$20 Billion to Drive Three Core Businesses
paras: 東森國際(2614-TW)公告上半年稅後純益2.73億元，年增7.4%，每股純益(EPS)0.83元， 整體獲利維持穩健成長，東森表示，將辦理現金增資，預計募集資金總額 20 億元，並持續推進倉儲、新媒體和新零售等核心事業。
東森國際上半年合併營收 25.45 億元，稅後純益2.73 億元，EPS 0.83 元。
東森現金增資案已獲主管機關核准生效，東森表示，將發行普通股 1 億 2500 萬股，每股面額新台幣 10 元，預計募集資金總額 20 億元，用於償還銀行借款，降低利息支出和財務負擔，進一步提升償債能力、強化資本結構和整體營運韌性。
本次現增發行新股10%由員工認購、10%對外公開承銷，其餘 80%由原股東依持股比例優先認購，後續將依相關法令和現金增資作業時程辦理認股基準日、發行價格等相關作業。
在事業布局方面，東森國際表示，持續推進倉儲、新媒體和新零售等核心事業。
而轉投資事業方面，東森購物上半年稅後純益 5.77 億元，EPS達6.61元，獲利穩健，正深化會員經營、多元通路整合和營運效率提升；自然美也積極推動營運模式轉型，上半年服務收入年增幅已逾 2 倍，將整合AI科技與美容健康服務。
paras_en: Eastern Broadcasting Corporation (2614-TW) announced a net profit of NT$2.73 billion in the first half, a year-on-year increase of 7.4%, with earnings per share (EPS) of NT$0.83. The company maintained a stable growth in overall profitability and stated that it will proceed with a cash capital increase, aiming to raise NT$20 billion, and continue to drive its core businesses in warehousing, new media, and new retail.
Eastern Broadcasting Corporation reported a combined revenue of NT$25.45 billion and a net profit of NT$2.73 billion in the first half, with EPS of NT$0.83.

The company's cash capital increase has been approved by the regulatory authorities and will issue 125 million new shares, each with a par value of NT$10, aiming to raise NT$20 billion to repay bank loans, reduce interest expenses, and strengthen its capital structure and overall operational resilience.

In this capital increase, 10% of the new shares will be allocated to employees, 10% will be publicly offered, and the remaining 80% will be allocated to existing shareholders in proportion to their holdings. The company will proceed with the relevant procedures, including the determination of the subscription date, issue price, and other related matters, in accordance with the relevant laws and regulations.
In terms of business layout, Eastern Broadcasting Corporation stated that it will continue to drive its core businesses in warehousing, new media, and new retail.

In terms of its investment portfolio, Eastern Shopping reported a net profit of NT$5.77 billion in the first half, with EPS of NT$6.61, maintaining stable profitability. The company is actively promoting its operational model transformation, with service revenue growing more than twice in the first half. Natural Beauty is also aggressively driving its operational model transformation, with service revenue growing more than twice in the first half, and plans to integrate AI technology with beauty and health services.

items.title: 〈台股開盤〉MSCI季調台股三升 台積電領權值股漲逾600點站上4萬6千點
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Opens with MSCI Quarterly Adjustment, TSMC Leads Value Stocks to Surge Over 600 Points to 46,142.97
paras: 台股今(13)日開盤受電子權值股上揚激勵，早盤迅速大漲逾650點，指數一度攻上4萬6千點，漲幅逾1.4％以上，電子權值股多檔勁揚領指數上攻，包括台積電(2330-TW)領權值股大漲，加上被動元件、入選MSCI最新公告的記憶體股大漲支援下，盤中暫報46,142.97點，漲1.36％或619點，今日成交量估1.45兆元。
MSCI明晟公布最新季度調整，台股本次在三大指數權重全面調升，而 MSCI 台灣指數成份股中，南亞科(2408-TW)、華邦電(2344-TW)、群聯(8299-TW)、南電(8046-TW)、台燿(6274-TW)、景碩(3189-TW) 等 6 檔新增入列，最新權重將在8/31收盤生效。
權值股部分，台積電(2330-TW)開高漲30元，來到2445元，漲逾1％以上；受惠挪威主權基金增持的聯發科(2454-TW)漲6％、國巨* (2327.TW)標上漲停板；台達電(2308 -TW)漲半根停板，鴻海(2330-TW)下跌2.2％，廣達(2382-TW)上漲0.92％。
金融股部分則是表現疲軟，華南金(2880-TW)下跌7％，兆豐金(2886-TW)跌4%、中信金(2891-TW)跌1.65％。
受AI需求持續升溫，被動元件族群7月營收表現亮眼，也在反應上股價表現上，除了國巨*漲停，光頡(3624-TW)、凱美(2375-TW)、華新科(2492-TW)聯袂攻上漲停板，密望實(8043 -TW)、金山電(8042 -TW)漲幅超過7％以上。
此外，因MSCI明晟公布最新季度調整，台股成分股中，新增記憶體類股南亞科(2408-TW)漲8%、群聯(8299-TW)漲1.36%、華邦電(2344-TW)漲3.11%；新增的ABF類股景碩(8299-TW)、南電(8046 -TW)、台耀(4746 -TW)則下跌兩樣情，跌幅2-3％。
法人表示，台股技術面延續短多趨勢，但量能持續偏低下，預期指數仍以偏多震盪為主，題材輪動上個股走勢分歧，投資人可參考短期技術均線換股偏多操作，題材類股部分，可留意光通訊、玻纖布、半導體鏈、銅概念、板卡、機器人等概念股。
paras_en: The Taiwan stock market opened today (13th) with a strong surge in electronic value stocks, with the index rising over 650 points in the morning session, reaching a high of 46,142.97, a gain of 1.36% or 619 points. The market's turnover is estimated to be 1.45 trillion NTD.

MSCI MSCI announced the latest quarterly adjustment, with Taiwan stocks seeing a significant increase in weight across the three major indices. Among the MSCI Taiwan index constituents, six stocks, including Nan Ya Plastics (2408-TW), Winbond Electronics (2344-TW), Group IC (8299-TW), Taipower (8046-TW), Ta Ya Steel (6274-TW), and Ching Shih (3189-TW), were added to the list, with the latest weights taking effect on August 31.

In the value stock sector, TSMC (2330-TW) opened high, rising 30 NTD to 2445 NTD, a gain of over 1%. Largan Precision (2454-TW) rose 6% after being boosted by Norway's sovereign fund, while United Microelectronics (2327-TW) rose to the upper limit, and Delta Electronics (2308-TW) rose half a point to the upper limit. Hon Hai (2327-TW) fell 2.2%, while Wistron (2382-TW) rose 0.92%.

The financial sector, however, showed a weak performance, with China Development Financial (2880-TW) falling 7%, Taishin Financial (2886-TW) falling 4%, and Chinatrust Financial (2891-TW) falling 1.65%.

The passive component sector, which has seen a surge in demand for AI, reported a bright 7% revenue growth in July, with stocks such as United Microelectronics (2327-TW), Largan Precision (2454-TW), Winbond Electronics (2492-TW), and Ching Shih (2375-TW) rising to the upper limit, while Micron Technology (8043-TW) and King Yuan Electronics (8042-TW) rose over 7%.

Additionally, due to MSCI's latest quarterly adjustment, the Taiwan stock market added memory-related stocks, including Nan Ya Plastics (2408-TW), which rose 8%, Group IC (8299-TW), which rose 1.36%, and Winbond Electronics (2344-TW), which rose 3.11%. The added ABF-related stocks, including Ching Shih (3189-TW), Taipower (8046-TW), and Ta Ya Steel (4746-TW), however, fell 2-3%.

Market analysts noted that the Taiwan stock market's technical indicators continue to show a short-term uptrend, but the market's volume remains low. They expect the index to continue to fluctuate with a bias towards the upside, with individual stocks showing divergent trends. Investors can consider short-term technical line trading with a bias towards the upside, while paying attention to theme-related stocks such as optical communication, fiber optics, semiconductor chains, copper concepts, PCBs, and robotics.

In the US market, the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 21.58 points or 0.04% to close at 53,770.27, while the Nasdaq Composite rose 143.04 points or 0.54% to close at 26,588.49. The S&P 500 rose 20.3 points or 0.26% to close at 7,748.5, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rose 300.9 points or 2.49% to close at 12,399.38.

items.title: 鴻海AI需求續強 法說會後美系、日系外資齊升目標價4字頭起跳
items.title_en: Foxconn AI Demand Continues to Strengthen, US and Japanese Institutional Investors Raise Target Price to 4-Digit Level
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)法說會後，外資紛紛出具最新報告指出，AI伺服器、ASIC及高速網通需求持續升溫，加上新一代AI機櫃及光通訊產品陸續進入量產，帶動鴻海未來獲利展望同步上修。其中，美系外資Citi維持「買進」評等，目標價由360元上調至400元；日系外資Nomura同樣維持「買進」，目標價由352元大幅調升至435元。
美系外資指出，鴻海AI業務能見度較3個月前進一步提升，主要受惠雲端服務供應商(CSP)資本支出持續增加，以及AI伺服器需求強勁，預期第三季AI機櫃出貨量將季增高雙位數，全年AI機櫃出貨量維持倍數成長。
此外，新一代VR AI機櫃預計第三季進入量產，第四季出貨加速，並有望於2027年成為主流產品；ASIC也將成為另一項重要成長動能，長期可望占AI伺服器出貨量約40%。網通方面，鴻海維持2026年800G以上交換器出貨量倍增目標，CPO及新一代高速交換器產品也將陸續放量。
美系外資並看好鴻海從AI伺服器進一步擴大至完整AI基礎建設，涵蓋AI機櫃、網通、模組化資料中心及超級運算中心等，垂直整合及自動化優勢可望帶動市占率、營運槓桿及獲利能力提升。
在獲利預估方面，美系外資預估鴻海2026年稅後純益達2707.36億元，年增42.9%，每股純益(EPS)19.45元；2027年稅後純益3494.40億元，年增29.1%，EPS 25.11元；2028年稅後純益4005.70億元，年增14.6%，EPS 28.78元。
日系外資則認為，AI仍是鴻海主要成長引擎，除既有CSP客戶外，Neocloud業者規模擴大，以及Google TPU等ASIC需求增加，都有望帶來額外訂單；同時，NVIDIA新一代平台及光通訊架構升級，也將推升鴻海AI伺服器及網通相關需求。
日系外資因此將鴻海2026至2028年獲利預估分別上修12.8%、23.4%及24.9%，並以2027年每股純益25.57元、17倍本益比評價，將目標價由352元上調至435元，維持「買進」評等。
paras_en: Foxconn (2317-TW) held a conference call after the law-making meeting, and institutional investors have issued their latest reports, pointing out that AI server, ASIC, and high-speed network demand continue to heat up. With the new generation of AI chassis and optical communication products entering mass production, Foxconn's future profit outlook has been revised upward simultaneously. Among them, US institutional investor Citi maintains a 'buy' rating, with a target price of 400 yuan, up from 360 yuan. Japanese institutional investor Nomura also maintains a 'buy' rating, with a target price of 435 yuan, up from 352 yuan.

US institutional investors point out that Foxconn's AI business visibility has further improved compared to three months ago, mainly benefiting from the continued increase in capital expenditures of cloud service providers (CSPs) and strong demand for AI servers. It is expected that the third-quarter AI chassis shipment will increase by double digits, and the annual AI chassis shipment will maintain a multiple growth.

In addition, the new generation of VR AI chassis is expected to enter mass production in the third quarter, with accelerated shipments in the fourth quarter, and is expected to become a mainstream product in 2027. ASIC will also become another important growth driver, with a long-term goal of occupying about 40% of AI server shipments. In terms of networking, Foxconn maintains its target of doubling 800G and above exchange shipments in 2026, and CPO and new-generation high-speed exchange products will be gradually released.

US institutional investors are also optimistic about Foxconn's expansion of AI server business to complete AI infrastructure, covering AI chassis, networking, modularized data centers, and supercomputing centers, etc. The advantages of vertical integration and automation are expected to drive up market share, operating leverage, and profitability.

In terms of profit estimates, US institutional investors estimate that Foxconn's net profit will reach NT$270.73 billion in 2026, up 42.9% year-on-year, with EPS of NT$19.45. In 2027, net profit is expected to reach NT$349.44 billion, up 29.1% year-on-year, with EPS of NT$25.11. In 2028, net profit is expected to reach NT$40.06 billion, up 14.6% year-on-year, with EPS of NT$28.78.

Japanese institutional investors believe that AI is still Foxconn's main growth engine. In addition to existing CSP customers, the expansion of Neocloud businesses and the increase in demand for Google TPU and ASIC are expected to bring additional orders. At the same time, NVIDIA's new-generation platform and optical communication framework upgrade will also drive up Foxconn's AI server and networking-related demand.

Japanese institutional investors have therefore revised Foxconn's profit estimates for 2026-2028 by 12.8%, 23.4%, and 24.9%, respectively, and valued the stock at NT$25.57 per share, 17 times the earnings multiple, with a target price of NT$435, up from NT$352, and maintaining a 'buy' rating.

items.title: 白銀多頭列車要加速！花旗喊上看90美元 潛在漲幅近4成
items.title_en: Silver Bull Train Must Accelerate! Citi Forecasts Up to $90, Potential Gain Near 40%
paras: 花旗最新重申對白銀的看多立場，預估隨著投資買盤接棒成為主要推力，銀價未來 3 個月可望升至每盎司 75 美元，未來 6 至 12 個月更可能挑戰 90 美元，較目前約 65 美元的現貨價格上漲約 38%。
花旗認為，白銀接下來的漲勢將不再主要仰賴工業用途，而是由資金流向主導。隨著荷姆茲海峽緊張局勢最終可望降溫，加上聯準會政策立場可能轉趨溫和，先前壓抑貴金屬的美元走強與實質利率上升等因素有望逐步消退，帶動白銀投資需求持續回升。
由於白銀通常與黃金同向波動，但價格彈性更高。
花旗形容，若荷姆茲海峽僵局迅速化解，白銀將成為押注貴金屬上漲的理想標的。該行基本情境預估，中東局勢最快可能在今年 9 月至 12 月間緩和，屆時白銀有望以更大幅度跟進金價上漲。
另一方面，白銀的工業需求前景開始出現結構性變化。太陽能業者持續減少單位電池的白銀用量，並加快採用背接觸式 (BC) 電池技術，可能使太陽能產業對白銀的需求成長放緩。花旗預估，BC 技術最快可於 2028 年成為太陽能市場的主流技術之一。
不過，人工智慧 (AI)、5G及電動車產業對白銀的需求仍具韌性，花旗預期全球白銀市場至少到 2027 年都將維持供不應求，為銀價提供中長期支撐。
印度市場也是另一項利多。目前印度國內銀價較國際價格溢價約 7%，反映當地買盤強勁。隨著第四季節慶及婚禮旺季到來，印度白銀需求可望進一步升溫。
paras_en: Citi reiterated its bullish stance on silver, estimating that with investment buying taking over as the main driver, the price could rise to $75 per ounce within the next three months and potentially challenge $90 within six to twelve months – about a 38% increase from the current spot price of roughly $65.

Citi believes the upcoming rally in silver will be driven less by industrial use and more by capital flows. As tensions in the Hormuz Strait are expected to ease and the Fed’s policy stance may become more dovish, the previously suppressive factors for precious metals—such as a strong dollar and rising real rates—should gradually recede, reviving investment demand for silver.
Silver typically moves in tandem with gold, but its price is more elastic.

Citi described that if the Hormuz Strait deadlock is resolved quickly, silver would become an ideal vehicle for betting on a rise in precious metals. The bank’s baseline scenario projects that the Middle‑East situation could ease as early as September to December this year, at which point silver is likely to follow gold’s gains with an even larger jump.

On the other hand, the outlook for silver’s industrial demand is beginning to shift structurally. Solar manufacturers are continuously reducing the amount of silver per cell and accelerating the adoption of back‑contact (BC) cell technology, which could slow the growth of silver demand from the solar sector. Citi estimates that BC technology could become one of the mainstream solar technologies as early as 2028.

Nevertheless, demand for silver from AI, 5G and electric‑vehicle industries remains resilient. Citi expects the global silver market to stay in deficit at least through 2027, providing medium‑ to long‑term support for prices.

India also offers a tailwind. Domestic silver prices in India carry a premium of about 7% over international levels, reflecting strong local buying. With the fourth‑quarter festive season and wedding rush approaching, Indian silver demand is expected to heat up further.

items.title: Anthropic傳砸60億美元買Decart 史上最大收購補強AI算力
items.title_en: Anthropic Spends $6 Billion to Acquire Decart in Largest Acquisition to Date
paras: 彭博引述消息人士報導，Anthropic正洽購同業 Decart AI，交易金額約達 60 億美元，若最終完成，將創下Anthropic迄今規模最大的收購紀錄，也正值其備受市場矚目的IPO前夕。
向來極少進行大型併購的 Anthropic，為了開發新產品與服務客戶，近年持續在算力上投入重金。
消息人士表示，Decart 的軟體能使晶片運作更具效率，進而降低訓練人工智慧模型的成本。這項技術有助於 Anthropic 現有基礎設施承載更龐大的需求。交易完成後，Decart 的團隊將加入 Anthropic 的推論與效能部門。
Decart 同時專注於生成式影片技術，利用所謂的「世界模型」（world models），即時修改直播影像。消息人士指出，這項技術也反映 Decart 擁有高水準的基礎設施技術人才。
Anthropic 與 Decart 的代表均拒絕置評。
Decart 今年 5 月表示，公司在由 Radical Ventures 領投的一輪融資中籌得 3 億美元，輝達(NVDA-US) 、Atreides Management、Valor Equity Partners 與 Adobe Ventures 也參與投資。既有投資人紅杉資本、Benchmark 與 Zeev Ventures 同樣參與本輪融資。
據《華爾街日報》報導，該輪融資對這家新創公司的估值逼近 40 億美元，高於 2025 年 8 月時的 31 億美元。
Decart 成立於 2023 年，由三名以色列工程師共同創辦，分別是兄弟 Dean Leitersdorf、Orian Leitersdorf，以及 Moshe Shalev。
OpenAI 與 Anthropic 都已承諾投入數百億、甚至數千億美元，興建配置昂貴晶片的資料中心。隨著運算需求急速攀升，兩家公司也愈來愈依賴不同供應商提供的硬體，以滿足龐大的算力需求。
隨著這兩家 AI 新創公司準備在未來幾個月內迎來華爾街首秀，這些被其高層認為是打造與支援尖端人工智慧模型不可或缺的龐大支出，也可能為其帶來財務壓力。
本篇不開放合作媒體轉載
paras_en: Bloomberg reported that Anthropic is in talks to acquire Decart AI, with a deal valued at around $6 billion, which would be the company's largest acquisition to date, coming at a time when it is preparing for its highly anticipated IPO.
Anthropic, which has historically been reluctant to make large acquisitions, has been investing heavily in computing power in recent years to develop new products and serve its customers.

According to sources, Decart's software enables chips to operate more efficiently, reducing the cost of training artificial intelligence models. This technology will help Anthropic's existing infrastructure handle larger demands.

Decart has also focused on generative video technology, using so-called 'world models' to modify live video in real-time. Sources say this technology reflects Decart's high level of infrastructure technology talent.
Representatives from Anthropic and Decart declined to comment.

Decart announced in May that it had raised $300 million in a funding round led by Radical Ventures, with NVIDIA (NVDA-US), Atreides Management, Valor Equity Partners, and Adobe Ventures also participating. Existing investors Redpoint Ventures, Benchmark, and Zeev Ventures also participated in the round.
According to a report by The Wall Street Journal, the funding round valued the company at around $4 billion, higher than its $3.1 billion valuation in August 2025.
Decart was founded in 2023 by three Israeli engineers, Dean Leitersdorf, Orian Leitersdorf, and Moshe Shalev.

Both OpenAI and Anthropic have committed to investing hundreds of billions, if not trillions, of dollars in building data centers equipped with expensive chips. As computing demands have skyrocketed, both companies have increasingly relied on hardware suppliers to meet their massive computing needs.

As these two AI startups prepare to go public on Wall Street in the coming months, these massive expenditures, which their executives believe are essential for building and supporting cutting-edge AI models, may also bring financial pressure.
