items.title: 硬體股大幅跑贏標普500！高盛最看好這三家公司
items.title_en: Hardware Stocks Outperform the S&P 500! Goldman Sachs’ Top Three Picks
paras: 人工智慧 (AI) 基礎建設投資持續升溫，高盛最新點名戴爾科技、慧與科技及NetApp為美國硬體產業三大首選股。高盛認為，AI伺服器需求快速成長，加上企業加速更新資料中心設備，可望繼續推升硬體業者營收與獲利。
美國硬體股今年第二季以來明顯跑贏大盤。高盛統計，4月1日至8月7日期間，標普500指數上漲18%，IT硬體類股上漲136%，戴爾科技、慧與科技與NetApp的漲幅則分別達168%、122%及86%。
高盛維持三家公司「買進」評等，但依據最新營運展望分別調整目標價，其中戴爾科技仍是首選。
戴爾科技：AI與傳統伺服器需求同步成長
高盛維持戴爾科技 (DELL-US)「買進」評等，並將12個月目標價由500美元調高至510美元。除了AI伺服器需求強勁，傳統伺服器業務展望改善，也是高盛上調財測的主要原因。
高盛預估，戴爾2027會計年度第二季營收將達448億美元，其中基礎設施解決方案事業群營收可望年增75%，用戶端解決方案事業群也將成長20%。調整後每股盈餘預估為4.96美元，高於公司財測區間上緣。
基於傳統伺服器營收預期上修，高盛將戴爾2027至2029會計年度每股盈餘預測平均調高4%。戴爾近期也推出搭載輝達 (NVDA-US) Vera Rubin架構的PowerEdge XE8812伺服器，進一步強化AI硬體產品布局。
不過，高盛提醒，個人電腦需求轉弱、企業IT支出放緩、同業價格競爭、零組件成本上升，以及白牌伺服器業者搶占市占率，可能對戴爾的成長與利潤率造成壓力。
慧與科技：網路設備成為另一成長引擎
高盛同樣維持慧與科技 (HPE-US)「買進」評等，但將12個月目標價由79美元下修至75美元。
高盛預估，慧與科技2026會計年度第三季營收將達120億美元，高於市場共識，其中雲端與AI業務營收可望年增22%，網路業務更可能大增77%。調整後每股盈餘預估為0.94美元，略高於公司財測區間上緣。
隨著超大規模雲端服務商擴建AI基礎設施，加上一般用途運算需求加速回升，高盛將慧與科技2026至2028會計年度每股盈餘預估平均上調2%，主要反映網路設備營收展望改善。
慧與科技近期獲得雲端服務商Vultr選用，參與大規模AI資料中心部署，並把Juniper Networks網路產品整合至AI資料中心解決方案，同時與8家公司擴大在量子運算領域的合作。
潛在風險則包括企業IT支出下滑、白牌設備競爭、整合Juniper期間流失市占率，以及零組件成本上升。
NetApp：企業儲存設備售價支撐成長
高盛維持資料儲存業者NetApp (NTAP-US)「買進」評等，並將12個月目標價由200美元調高至210美元，主要看好企業基礎設施支出，以及儲存設備平均售價上升。
高盛預估，NetApp 2027會計年度第一季營收將達18.1億美元，每股盈餘為2.12美元，略高於公司財測中間值。基於儲存設備平均售價提高，高盛將2027至2029會計年度營收與每股盈餘預測分別平均上調5%及4%。
NetApp上一季營收與獲利均優於市場預期，帶動Argus與巴克萊等機構調高目標價。公司近期也宣布收購AI資料基礎設施業者DataPelago，以擴充AI資料管理能力。
高盛提醒，NetApp仍可能面臨供應短缺、企業本地部署儲存設備需求長期下滑、產業競爭加劇，以及全球總體經濟轉弱等風險。
paras_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure investment continues to heat up, and Goldman Sachs has recently highlighted Dell Technologies, Hewlett Packard Enterprise and NetApp as the three top U.S. hardware stocks. Goldman Sachs believes that rapid growth in AI server demand, combined with enterprises accelerating data‑center upgrades, should keep driving revenue and profit growth for hardware makers.

U.S. hardware stocks have clearly outperformed the broader market since the second quarter of this year. Goldman Sachs calculated that from April 1 to August 7, the S&P 500 rose 18%, while IT hardware stocks jumped 136%, with Dell Technologies, Hewlett Packard Enterprise and NetApp gaining 168%, 122% and 86% respectively.
Goldman Sachs maintains a “Buy” rating on all three companies but has adjusted their target prices based on the latest operating outlook, keeping Dell Technologies as the top pick.
Dell Technologies: AI and Traditional Server Demand Growing Together

Goldman Sachs keeps a “Buy” rating on Dell Technologies (DELL‑US) and raises its 12‑month target price from $500 to $510. In addition to strong AI server demand, an improving outlook for the traditional server business is the main reason for the upgraded financial forecasts.

Goldman Sachs estimates that Dell’s fiscal 2027 second‑quarter revenue will reach $44.8 billion, with the infrastructure solutions segment expected to grow 75% year‑over‑year and the client solutions segment to expand 20%. Adjusted earnings per share are projected at $4.96, above the upper end of the company’s own guidance range.

Based on the upward revision to traditional server revenue, Goldman Sachs lifts its average EPS forecast for Dell for fiscal 2027‑2029 by 4%. Dell recently introduced the PowerEdge XE8812 server built on Nvidia’s (NVDA‑US) Vera Rubin architecture, further strengthening its AI hardware portfolio.

However, Goldman Sachs cautions that weakening PC demand, slower enterprise IT spending, competitive pricing pressure, rising component costs and white‑label server vendors gaining market share could pressure Dell’s growth and margins.
Hewlett Packard Enterprise: Network Gear Becomes Another Growth Engine
Goldman Sachs also maintains a “Buy” rating on Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE‑US) but cuts its 12‑month target price from $79 to $75.

Goldman Sachs projects that HPE’s fiscal 2026 third‑quarter revenue will reach $12 billion, above market consensus, with cloud and AI revenues expected to grow 22% annually and networking revenues potentially surging 77%. Adjusted EPS is estimated at $0.94, slightly above the top of the company’s guidance range.

With hyperscale cloud providers expanding AI infrastructure and general‑purpose compute demand rebounding, Goldman Sachs raises its average EPS forecast for HPE for fiscal 2026‑2028 by 2%, reflecting an improved outlook for networking equipment revenue.

HPE recently won a deal with cloud provider Vultr to participate in large‑scale AI data‑center deployments, integrated Juniper Networks networking products into its AI data‑center solutions, and expanded collaborations with eight firms in the quantum‑computing space.
Potential risks include a slowdown in enterprise IT spending, competition from white‑label equipment, market‑share loss during Juniper integration, and rising component costs.
NetApp: Enterprise Storage Prices Support Growth

Goldman Sachs keeps a “Buy” rating on data‑storage company NetApp (NTAP‑US) and raises its 12‑month target price from $200 to $210, mainly due to confidence in enterprise infrastructure spending and rising average selling prices for storage gear.

Goldman Sachs estimates NetApp’s fiscal 2027 first‑quarter revenue at $1.81 billion, with EPS of $2.12, slightly above the company’s midpoint guidance. Based on higher average storage‑equipment prices, it lifts its revenue and EPS forecasts for fiscal 2027‑2029 by an average of 5% and 4% respectively.

NetApp’s last quarter revenue and profit both beat market expectations, prompting firms such as Argus and Barclays to raise their target prices. The company also announced the acquisition of AI data‑infrastructure provider DataPelago to expand its AI data‑management capabilities.

Goldman Sachs warns that NetApp could still face supply shortages, a long‑term decline in on‑premises storage demand, intensifying industry competition, and a weakening global macro‑economic environment.

items.title: 特斯拉大招來了！馬斯克：未來特斯拉所有車輛都將導入星鏈 唯中國市場仍有變數
items.title_en: Tesla to Integrate Starlink into All Vehicles, with Exceptions
paras: 特斯拉(TSLA-US)執行長馬斯克近期宣布, 未來特斯拉旗下所有車款都將整合SpaceX旗下星鏈(Starlink)衛星網路, 但目前僅確定適用於星鏈已提供服務的市場, 尚未公布全面導入的具體時間表。馬斯克表示, 隨著Robotaxi擴大部署, 車輛不能因蜂窩網路死角而失去連線, 星鏈將成為重要的備援與高速連網方案。
馬斯克是在特斯拉第2季財報電話會議上談到與SpaceX合作時透露這項規劃。他表示, 星鏈目前正在整合至Cybercab, 未來也會整合到所有特斯拉車輛, 「至少是在星鏈已經啟用的市場」。馬斯克解釋, Robotaxi需要在各個地點維持連線, 即使是在矽谷, 仍存在蜂窩網路訊號不佳甚至完全沒有訊號的區域, 因此不能讓無人計程車卡在這些「蜂窩網路死角」中。
這項規劃近期再度受到關注, 原因是特斯拉本周公開展示首輛整合星鏈的Cybercab。特斯拉8月10日發布照片, 顯示星鏈設備已直接整合至Cybercab車頂結構, 不再需要外掛大型衛星天線。馬斯克隨後表示, Cybercab乘客可以在車內觀看4K直播、電影、玩遊戲或進行生產力工作, 顯示星鏈除了支援車輛本身的通訊需求, 也可能成為Robotaxi的車內娛樂及Wi-Fi基礎設施。
Cybercab被視為星鏈車載化的第一個重要測試案例。相關技術資訊顯示, 星鏈終端被嵌入Cybercab車頂, 以降低外露設備對車體外觀及空氣動力設計的影響。特斯拉AI主管Ashok Elluswamy此前也指出, 衛星網路並非自動駕駛本身的必要條件, 主要用途是提供導航、車隊管理以及偏遠地區的備援連線。
對特斯拉而言, 星鏈最大的價值並不只是讓乘客在車內上網, 而是為Robotaxi建立更具韌性的通信網路。現有蜂窩網路仍可能受到地形、人口密度、基地台覆蓋以及道路位置影響, 自駕車若在高速公路、偏遠地區或其他訊號較弱的區域失去與雲端及車隊管理系統的通信, 將增加營運難度。
馬斯克在財報會議上甚至提出更進一步的構想, 認為安裝在特斯拉車輛上的星鏈終端未來可能作為地面上的「連線中繼」或類似基地台的節點, 為附近手機及其他裝置提供Wi-Fi或網路連線。這顯示特斯拉可能不只是把Starlink視為單一車輛的網路設備, 而是希望把大量汽車轉化成分散式通信節點。
不過, 「所有特斯拉都會有星鏈」與「所有特斯拉都能立即使用星鏈」並不是同一件事。馬斯克目前的說法明確加上「星鏈已啟用的市場」這項限制, 代表衛星網路的監管許可、服務覆蓋及當地通信政策, 都會影響實際落地速度。特斯拉目前也沒有公布哪些既有車款可以透過升級硬體取得星鏈, 或是否會提供舊車加裝方案。
此外, 車載星鏈的成本也是大規模普及必須面對的問題。星鏈目前不同市場及方案的價格差異很大, 官方服務方案顯示, 部分Roam服務價格約從每月50美元起, 無限流量方案則可達每月105美元; 其他市場的方案價格也可能達到每月160美元以上。這些價格主要是現有Starlink服務方案, 並非特斯拉已公布的車載星鏈售價, 因此不能直接視為未來特斯拉車主必須支付的月費。
更重要的是, 特斯拉目前並沒有公布星鏈車載服務是否會納入車輛售價、是否需要額外訂閱, 或由特斯拉統一負擔服務費用。若未來每輛車都配備衛星終端, 硬體成本、電力消耗、衛星網路服務費及維護成本都可能成為特斯拉需要處理的新增支出。
星鏈本身也不是在所有環境下都能取代蜂窩網路。衛星通信高度依賴車輛與天空之間的可視條件, 高樓、隧道、地下停車場、山區以及茂密樹林等環境都可能造成遮蔽。2026年的研究也指出, 星鏈在移動環境中會因視線受阻及訊號品質變化而進行動態衛星切換, 當連線品質下降時, 網路效能可能受到影響。
換句話說, 星鏈更可能是蜂窩網路的補充, 而非全面取代4G或5G。對一般城市通勤而言, 蜂窩網路仍具有成本低、覆蓋成熟及室內穿透等優勢; 對Robotaxi而言, Starlink則可在蜂窩網路不足的地點提供額外的通信冗餘, 降低車隊因失聯而無法正常營運的風險。
特斯拉目前在台灣提供的車輛連線服務仍以既有的標準及頂級連線功能為主, 官方列出的功能包括導航、即時路況、衛星檢視地圖、哨兵模式遠端查看、音樂串流、影片串流及網路瀏覽器等, 部分功能可透過Wi-Fi使用。官方目前並未在台灣連線服務頁面宣布星鏈車載服務。
中國市場的情況則更加複雜。星鏈目前並未在中國大陸提供一般消費者衛星網路服務, 因此即使特斯拉未來將星鏈硬體整合進車輛, 也不代表中國大陸車主能直接啟用服務。中國工業和信息化部已陸續向中國電信、中國聯通及中國移動核發衛星移動通信業務經營許可, 可依法開展手機直連衛星等服務, 但這與星鏈在中國大陸提供完整車載衛星寬頻服務仍是不同的監管與商業問題。
因此, 中國大陸特斯拉車主能否使用星鏈, 關鍵並不只是車輛有沒有安裝衛星天線, 還涉及星鏈是否取得當地服務所需的監管許可、頻譜與通信資質, 以及特斯拉是否針對中國市場推出相應方案。目前沒有證據顯示特斯拉已公布中國大陸市場的星鏈商業化時間表。
星鏈車載化的背景, 也與馬斯克旗下企業近年更加緊密的協同有關。特斯拉目前已在車輛中導入SpaceX旗下AI系統Grok, SpaceX則採購特斯拉Megapack及車輛, 雙方並推動Terafab晶片工廠等合作。隨著Starlink進入Cybercab, 馬斯克旗下企業之間的技術及商業整合程度進一步提高。
這項整合對Robotaxi尤其重要。特斯拉正在把Cybercab視為未來自駕車服務的核心產品, 而無人車隊與一般私人乘用車最大的差異之一, 就是車輛需要持續接受車隊調度、導航資訊、軟體更新及遠端管理。雖然自動駕駛主要依賴車內感測器與運算能力, 並不代表每個駕駛決策都需要透過網路完成, 但穩定通信可以提高車隊營運效率及故障處理能力。
因此, 馬斯克宣布所有車輛最終導入星鏈, 更值得關注的其實是特斯拉未來汽車的定位正在改變。汽車不再只是依靠4G或5G連網的終端, 而可能成為具備衛星通信能力的移動網路節點, 並與Robotaxi、AI、車隊管理及車內娛樂服務形成新的生態系。
對星鏈而言, 特斯拉則可能成為一個規模龐大的車載終端市場。SpaceX近期持續擴大星鏈商業版圖, 星鏈已成為SpaceX重要的營收來源。隨著車載、航空、海事及手機直連衛星等服務持續擴張, 星鏈的定位也逐漸從偏遠地區寬頻服務商, 向更廣泛的全球通信基礎設施平台轉型。
不過, 特斯拉目前尚未公布全系車款導入星鏈的具體時間、硬體規格、服務價格及既有車輛升級方案。因此, 現階段最確定的訊息是Cybercab已開始整合星鏈, 而馬斯克已在財報會議上明確表示, 未來所有特斯拉車輛都將導入星鏈, 但前提是所在市場已有星鏈服務。
對消費者而言, 真正值得等待的並不是「特斯拉會不會裝星鏈」, 而是特斯拉最後會如何定價、哪些車型先導入、舊車能否升級, 以及星鏈究竟會成為免費的基礎連線功能, 還是另一項需要車主額外付費的訂閱服務。這些細節目前都仍未揭曉。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) CEO Elon Musk recently announced that all future Tesla models will be integrated with SpaceX's Starlink satellite network, but only in markets where Starlink is already available. Musk stated that as Robotaxi expands, vehicles cannot afford to lose connection due to cellular network dead zones, and Starlink will serve as a crucial backup and high-speed internet solution.

Musk revealed this plan during Tesla's Q2 earnings call, stating that Starlink is being integrated into Cybercab and will eventually be integrated into all Tesla vehicles, 'at least in markets where Starlink is already available.' Musk explained that Robotaxi needs to maintain connectivity in various locations, even in areas with poor or no cellular signal, and cannot be hindered by 'cellular dead zones.'

This plan has garnered attention recently due to Tesla's public showcase of the first Cybercab with integrated Starlink. On August 10, Tesla released photos showing Starlink equipment directly integrated into the Cybercab's roof structure, eliminating the need for external satellite antennas. Musk later stated that Cybercab passengers can watch 4K live streams, movies, play games, or work inside the vehicle, demonstrating Starlink's potential to support in-vehicle entertainment and Wi-Fi infrastructure.

Cybercab is seen as the first significant test case for Starlink's vehicle integration. Technical information reveals that Starlink terminals are embedded in the Cybercab's roof to minimize the impact of external devices on the vehicle's design and aerodynamics. Tesla's AI chief, Ashok Elluswamy, previously noted that satellite networks are not a necessary condition for autonomous driving but are primarily used for navigation, fleet management, and backup connectivity in remote areas.

For Tesla, Starlink's greatest value lies not only in providing passengers with in-vehicle internet but also in establishing a more resilient communication network for Robotaxi. Existing cellular networks can still be affected by terrain, population density, base station coverage, and road location, and self-driving cars that lose connection with the cloud and fleet management systems in areas with weak signals will face operational difficulties.

Musk even proposed a more advanced concept during the earnings call, suggesting that Starlink terminals installed in Tesla vehicles could serve as 'connection relays' or base station-like nodes, providing Wi-Fi or internet connectivity to nearby devices. This indicates that Tesla may not only view Starlink as a single-vehicle network device but also as a means to transform a large number of vehicles into decentralized communication nodes.

However, 'all Teslas will have Starlink' and 'all Teslas can immediately use Starlink' are not the same thing. Musk's current statement explicitly adds the limitation of 'markets where Starlink is already available,' implying that regulatory approvals, service coverage, and local communication policies will impact the actual rollout speed. Tesla has not announced which existing models can be upgraded to support Starlink or if there will be an upgrade program for older vehicles.

Additionally, the cost of vehicle-integrated Starlink is a significant issue that must be addressed for large-scale adoption. Starlink's prices vary greatly across different markets and plans, with some Roam services starting at around $50 per month and unlimited data plans reaching up to $105 per month. These prices are for existing Starlink services and not the announced prices for Tesla's vehicle-integrated Starlink, so they cannot be directly taken as the monthly fees that future Tesla owners will have to pay.

More importantly, Tesla has not disclosed whether the Starlink vehicle service will be included in the vehicle's purchase price, require a separate subscription, or be covered by Tesla's service fees. If every vehicle is equipped with a satellite terminal in the future, hardware costs, power consumption, satellite network service fees, and maintenance costs could all become new expenses for Tesla to handle.

Starlink is not a replacement for cellular networks in all environments. Satellite communication heavily relies on the line of sight between the vehicle and the sky, and environments like high-rise buildings, tunnels, underground parking lots, mountainous areas, and dense forests can cause obstruction. Research in 2026 also pointed out that Starlink may perform dynamic satellite switching in mobile environments due to blocked lines of sight and changing signal quality, which can affect network performance when connection quality degrades.

In other words, Starlink is more likely to complement cellular networks rather than fully replace 4G or 5G. For general urban commutes, cellular networks still have the advantages of low cost, mature coverage, and indoor penetration; for Robotaxi, Starlink can provide additional communication redundancy in areas where cellular networks are insufficient, reducing the risk of fleet operation disruptions due to lost connections.

Tesla currently offers vehicle connectivity services in Taiwan, focusing on standard and premium connectivity features, including navigation, real-time traffic, satellite map view, remote monitoring, music streaming, video streaming, and web browsing, with some features accessible via Wi-Fi. However, Tesla has not announced Starlink vehicle services on its Taiwan connectivity page.

The situation in the Chinese market is more complex. Starlink has not been made available to general consumers in mainland China, so even if Tesla integrates Starlink hardware into vehicles in the future, it does not mean that Chinese mainland car owners can directly activate the service. China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology has issued licenses for satellite mobile communication services to Chinese telecom operators, but this is a different regulatory and commercial issue than Starlink providing full vehicle-mounted satellite broadband services in China.

Therefore, whether Chinese mainland Tesla owners can use Starlink depends not only on the vehicle being equipped with a satellite antenna but also on whether Starlink obtains the necessary regulatory approvals, spectrum, and communication qualifications for local services, as well as whether Tesla launches corresponding plans for the Chinese market. There is currently no evidence that Tesla has announced a commercialization timeline for Starlink in the Chinese mainland market.

The background of Starlink's vehicle integration is also related to the increasingly close cooperation between Musk's companies in recent years. Tesla has introduced SpaceX's AI system, Grok, into its vehicles, while SpaceX has purchased Tesla's Megapack and vehicles, and both are promoting cooperation on the Terafab chip factory. As Starlink enters Cybercab, the degree of technological and business integration between Musk's companies has further increased.

This integration is particularly important for Robotaxi. Tesla views Cybercab as the core product for future self-driving car services, and the biggest difference between autonomous fleets and private vehicles is the need for continuous reception of fleet scheduling, navigation information, software updates, and remote management. Although autonomous driving primarily relies on in-vehicle sensors and computing capabilities, stable communication can enhance fleet operation efficiency and fault handling capability.

Thus, Musk's announcement that all vehicles will eventually integrate Starlink is more noteworthy because it signifies a change in the positioning of Tesla's future cars. Cars are no longer just 4G or 5G connected terminals but may become mobile network nodes with satellite communication capabilities, forming a new ecosystem with Robotaxi, AI, fleet management, and in-vehicle entertainment services.

For Starlink, Tesla could become a vast market for vehicle-mounted terminals. SpaceX has been expanding Starlink's commercial footprint, and Starlink has become an important source of revenue for SpaceX. As vehicle, aviation, maritime, and direct-to-phone satellite services continue to expand, Starlink's positioning is gradually shifting from a remote area broadband service provider to a more comprehensive global communication infrastructure platform.

However, Tesla has not disclosed the specific timeline, hardware specifications, service prices, or upgrade plans for existing vehicles to integrate Starlink across its entire lineup. Therefore, the most confirmed information at this stage is that Cybercab has begun integrating Starlink, and Musk has stated that all future Tesla vehicles will have Starlink, but only in markets where the service is already available.

For consumers, what is truly worth waiting for is not 'whether Tesla will install Starlink' but how Tesla will price the service, which models will be integrated first, whether older cars can be upgraded, and whether Starlink will become a free basic connectivity feature or another subscription service that car owners need to pay for. These details remain unannounced.

items.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro上線 性能逼近Fable 5 價格只有它的2%
paras: DeepSeek V4 Pro正式版於周三(12日)上線。目前DeepSeek未發布推文，唯一跡象是官網API定價頁面上的一行字變了，「deepseek-v4-pro」後面的版本號從預覽版變為DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813。
這也意味著從2026年4月起以預覽版形式提供服務的旗艦模型，終於正式轉正。
據了解，DeepSeek V4 Pro是一個混合專家（MoE）模型，總參數量達到1.6兆，每個token激活490億參數，上下文窗口為100萬token，最大可以輸出38.4萬token，這個規模放在全球AI模型中位居第一梯隊。此前第三方測試主要使用預覽版本，相關模型在Hugging Face等平台已有大量下載。
正式版上線後的價格與非高峰時段價格保持一致。這一價格其實就是2026年5月永久降價至原價四分之一後的標準價格，具體來說，每百萬輸入token收費0.435美元，輸出收費0.87美元，緩存命中的輸入收費只需要0.003625美元。
相比之下，Anthropic的Claude Fable 5每百萬輸入token收費10美元，輸出收費50美元。以輸出token價格計算，兩者相差近58倍，DeepSeek V4 Pro的價格還不到Claude Fable 5的2%。
要是按完成單個任務的成本來算，差距可能更加明顯。有機構測試過，使用Claude Fable 5完成一個基準任務花費3.15美元，使用DeepSeek V4 Flash只需花費3美分，兩者相差100倍。DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813版本的單任務成本目前還缺乏充分的第三方測試，但由於目前API價格體系沒有變化，實際成本差距仍可能相當可觀。
之所以價格差距能拉這麼大，主要與架構設計有關。DeepSeek V4 Pro使用了兩種注意力變體，分別是壓縮稀疏注意力（Compressed Sparse Attention）和重度壓縮注意力（Heavily Compressed Attention）。
按照DeepSeek的說法，這套架構能夠把單token推理計算量降至V3.2的27%，KV緩存則降至原來的10%。這對於100萬token的上下文窗口來說，能夠節省的成本相當可觀。由於推理效率提高，也為模型提供了更大的定價空間。
DeepSeek自己也進行了基準測試，在10項智能體評測中與Claude Fable 5進行比較。去掉差距最大的一項之後（Humanity"s Last Exam，DeepSeek V4 Pro落後10.6個百分點），剩下9項中DeepSeek平均落後2.8%，其中有2項DeepSeek勝出。
不過，這些數據是DeepSeek自行測試的結果，使用的是自家尚未對外開放的評測框架，而且相關內部測試集也沒有公開榜單可以驗證。因此，DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813版本的實際表現，仍有待第三方評測進一步確認。上述數據目前只能說明DeepSeek認為V4 Pro在部分測試中已接近Claude Fable 5，尚不能直接視為兩者整體性能相當。
DeepSeek V4 Pro在API中提供不同程度的推理模式，包括非思考及不同推理強度的設定。其中，較高的推理模式可以進一步提升模型的推理能力。API同時支援OpenAI和Anthropic兩種格式的接口，先前已在這兩個生態系統中開發的開發者無需大幅修改程式碼即可切換使用，同時支援工具調用、結構化JSON輸出等功能。
DeepSeek V4 Pro正式版上線後，DeepSeek V4系列的產品結構變得更加清晰：一方面，Flash版本負責高頻、高併發的使用場景，主打低價格；Pro版本則將更多算力集中在複雜推理、長上下文編碼及智能體任務上。部分AI開發公司已開始搭配使用兩種版本。
不過，DeepSeek的定價頁面也已預告，近期將進行一次「顯著的價格調整」。至於具體漲幅以及何時調整，目前尚未公布，因此目前這個低價窗口還能維持多久，仍有待觀察。
同時，多家聚合平台的數據顯示，2026年7月DeepSeek模型的Token調用規模已位居全球AI模型第一梯隊，在部分榜單中僅次於Anthropic的模型。DeepSeek的業務增長主要依託開發者的實際API調用，迄今為止也沒有舉辦大型媒體發布會，主要透過公眾號宣布產品消息，有時也會發布技術博客。
眾所周知，DeepSeek的算力儲備相較海外AI頭部企業並不算大。根據7月流出的投資人交流會內容，梁文鋒曾提到，當時DeepSeek擁有約2萬張H100等效算力。這個數字與海外AI頭部大廠動輒幾十萬甚至上百萬張GPU的集群相比，確實不在同一個量級。
不過，梁文鋒也表示這個數字是動態的，DeepSeek一直在努力採購更多算力，並計畫「在合理價格內能買多少卡就買多少卡」。與此同時，DeepSeek據報也在規劃GW級的自建算力基礎設施，近期針對內蒙古資料中心相關職位的招聘，也被外界視為其擴充算力布局的跡象。
DeepSeek還與華為合作。根據流出的投資人交流會內容，DeepSeek獲得華為約1.6萬張昇騰950算力卡的配置，用於軟體生態驗證與落地。另有第三方機構已在中國國產算力集群（昇騰910C）上完成DeepSeek V4 Pro的全參數後訓練，這顯示國產算力正在逐步承擔更重的AI模型訓練任務。
目前DeepSeek V4系列採用MIT授權的開放權重模式。至於DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813正式版權重的公開進度，仍需以官方後續公告為準。按照V4 Flash「API先跑、權重隨後跟上」的節奏，市場仍在等待正式版權重的進一步消息。
第三方評測機構目前也正在陸續測試DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813版本。待更多獨立評測數據公布後，才能更清楚判斷DeepSeek V4 Pro這次的性能提升幅度，以及它與Claude Fable 5等頂級模型之間的實際差距。

items.title: 不缺需求缺算力！摩根士丹利警告：AI供應瓶頸恐持續數年
items.title_en: Demand Not Lacking, But Computing Power Is: Morgan Stanley Warns of AI Supply Bottleneck
paras: 隨著企業人工智慧(AI)應用不斷深化，越來越多公司已經開始從AI投資中獲得可量化回報，但摩根士丹利(下稱大摩)認為，算力供應不足正在成為限制AI產業進一步擴張的關鍵瓶頸，而電力、勞動力以及政治層面的約束可能使這一問題在未來數年持續存在。
大摩美國主題研究策略師Michelle Weaver周三(12日)表示，企業對AI應用正日益產生實質成效，但算力供應受限仍是限製成長的瓶頸。 「我們的供應非常不足。我們看到算力在成為一種受限資源。電力瓶頸、政治瓶頸、勞動瓶頸－這些因素將在未來幾年制約供應。」
她也指出，25%的標普500指數成分股公司如今可以量化AI投資所帶來的回報，高於一年前的14%，資料中心融資也十分充裕，輝達與華爾街金融機構合作為AI基礎設施籌集5000億美元就是例證。
目前，AI資料中心(AIDC)對於高可靠性備用電源需求顯著提升，高功率、高壓化、智慧併機等產品升級趨勢明確，資料中心已成為柴油引擎及發電機組產業最重要的增量方向。
中金公司出具研報指出，今年電力設備產業整體表現穩健向上，提示投資人專注於結構性機會。
中金認為，全球電力大周期開啟端倪初現，新型電力系統發展是一個長期、持續的過程，景氣度或可持續至2030年，而主要上市公司訂單、收入、獲利仍在紮實的上升通道，歷經調整後當前估值已進入歷史低估區間，相關類股具備長期投資價值。
paras_en: As corporate applications of artificial intelligence (AI) continue to deepen, an increasing number of companies are now generating quantifiable returns from their AI investments. However, Morgan Stanley (hereinafter referred to as MS) believes that a shortage of computing power is becoming a critical bottleneck limiting the further expansion of the AI industry, with power, labor, and political constraints potentially making this issue persist for several years to come.

MS US Thematic Research Strategist Michelle Weaver stated on Wednesday (12th) that companies are increasingly generating tangible results from their AI applications, but the limited supply of computing power remains a bottleneck limiting growth. "Our supply is extremely insufficient. We see computing power becoming a limited resource. Power bottlenecks, political bottlenecks, labor bottlenecks – these factors will constrain supply over the next few years."

She also pointed out that 25% of S&P 500 constituent companies can now quantify the returns from their AI investments, higher than the 14% a year ago, and data center financing is also very abundant, with the example of NVIDIA and Wall Street financial institutions raising $500 billion for AI infrastructure.

Currently, AI data centers (AIDC) have significantly increased demand for high-reliability backup power, with clear trends of upgrading to high-power, high-voltage, and intelligent paralleling products, and data centers have become the most important growth direction for diesel engines and power generation sets.

A research report from China Securities (Zijin) pointed out that the overall performance of the power equipment industry was stable and upward this year, suggesting that investors focus on structural opportunities.

China Securities believes that the global power cycle is beginning to emerge, and the development of new power systems is a long-term and continuous process, with the economic cycle potentially lasting until 2030, and major listed companies' orders, revenue, and profits are still in a solid upward channel, with the current valuation entering a historical undervaluation range, and related stocks have long-term investment value.

items.title: Palantir、微軟走低 為何AI行情復甦衝擊軟體股？
items.title_en: Palantir, Microsoft Fall as AI Rally Hits Software Stocks
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，市場目前似乎已形成一個現象：當晶片與網路設備股上漲時，軟體股就會下跌。這股動態周三(12日)再次上演，隨著AI行情重新升溫，Palantir(PLTR-US)與微軟(MSFT-US)成為標普500指數表現最差個股之一。
Palantir股價下跌2.2%，微軟下跌2.3%。Salesforce(CRM-US)、ServiceNow(NOW-US)及Workday(WDAY-US)等其他軟體股也紛紛走低。
在此同時，晶片及光纖網路設備業者股價上漲。此前一批強勁的企業財報顯示，AI需求依然旺盛，進一步帶動相關類股走高。
軟體股與晶片股往往呈現不同走勢，原因在於投資人對這兩個產業在AI發展中的角色有不同看法。
大型語言模型(LLM)需要晶片提供運算能力，而資料中心大規模擴建，也推升了對光纖電纜及其他網路設備的需求。
同時，市場預期AI將對軟體產業帶來重大顛覆，因為所謂的「氛圍式程式設計」(vibe coding)工具快速發展，可能使部分現有軟體產品逐漸失去市場。
不過，這種市場動態也是雙向的。由於市場擔心晶片股估值過高，Palantir與微軟過去3個月仍分別大漲32%及22%。
paras_en: A phenomenon has emerged in the market: when chip and network equipment stocks rise, software stocks fall. This dynamic played out again on Wednesday (12th), as the AI trend heated up, with Palantir (PLTR-US) and Microsoft (MSFT-US) becoming among the worst performers in the S&P 500.
Palantir's stock price fell 2.2%, while Microsoft fell 2.3%. Other software stocks, including Salesforce (CRM-US), ServiceNow (NOW-US), and Workday (WDAY-US), also fell.
Meanwhile, chip and fiber-optic network equipment stocks rose, following a batch of strong earnings reports that showed AI demand remains strong, driving related stocks higher.
Software and chip stocks often have different trends, due to investors' differing views on the roles of these two industries in AI development.
Large language models (LLMs) require chips to provide computing power, while data center expansion also drives demand for fiber-optic cables and other network equipment.
At the same time, the market expects AI to bring significant disruption to the software industry, as 'vibe coding' tools rapidly develop, potentially making some existing software products obsolete.
However, this market dynamic is two-way. Due to concerns that chip stocks are overvalued, Palantir and Microsoft have risen 32% and 22% respectively over the past three months.

items.title: 全球長錢盯上AI記憶體 淡馬錫傳擬直接投資三星與SK海力士
paras: 新加坡主權財富基金淡馬錫傳出計畫直接投資韓國記憶體大廠三星電子與SK海力士, 消息在8月12日刺激韓股記憶體族群大漲。這項動作不僅反映市場對AI基礎建設長期需求的信心, 也凸顯全球大型長期資金正把投資焦點從AI模型與運算晶片, 延伸至支撐AI運算的記憶體、資料中心及能源基礎設施。
韓國媒體8月12日報導, 淡馬錫近期已決定直接投資三星電子與SK海力士, 並與韓國政府接觸評估投資時機, 擬透過內部投資團隊進場, 而非交由外部資產管理公司操作。相關消息帶動三星電子與SK海力士股價一度大漲逾8%, KOSPI也同步走強。彭博等媒體後續報導指出, 淡馬錫並未確認具體投資計畫, 因此目前仍應視為市場消息, 而非已完成的投資。
這項消息之所以受到市場高度關注, 在於淡馬錫並非一般短線資金。淡馬錫最新公布的2026年度報告顯示, 截至今年3月底, 其投資組合淨值達5,180億新元, 較前一年度增加490億新元, 過去10年股東總回報率為7.1%, 過去20年則為6.8%。過去一財年, 淡馬錫投入510億新元、撤資310億新元, 淨投資金額達200億新元。
更重要的是, AI已經成為淡馬錫未來多年資產配置的核心方向。淡馬錫目前AI相關投資約占整體投資組合6%, 計畫在2031年前提高至最高15%。公司規劃將資金分散配置於AI價值鏈五大領域, 包括能源與資料中心、半導體、雲端服務供應商、基礎模型, 以及AI應用與軟體基礎設施。
這意味著淡馬錫若真的在此時將資金投入三星電子與SK海力士, 並非單純押注兩家韓國企業的股價反彈, 更可能是其AI長期投資策略在記憶體領域的延伸。
在AI產業鏈中, 記憶體正逐漸從傳統半導體零組件轉變成AI基礎設施的關鍵瓶頸。大型AI模型需要大量高頻寬記憶體(HBM)與高速DRAM, AI伺服器數量快速增加也推升高容量記憶體需求。三星電子與SK海力士目前都是全球主要記憶體供應商, 其中SK海力士更在HBM市場占有重要地位。
近期韓國記憶體股之所以出現劇烈波動, 正是因為市場在AI資本支出是否能持續高速成長的問題上出現分歧。7月韓股科技股遭遇明顯拋售後, 淡馬錫可能進場的消息被市場解讀為長期資金對記憶體產業基本面的背書, 也帶動其他記憶體股及半導體股同步反彈。相關市場報導顯示, SK海力士美國掛牌ADR也一度上漲約9%, 顯示影響並不限於韓國市場。
淡馬錫目前的AI投資版圖其實已涵蓋半導體及AI生態系多個環節。其投資組合涉及NVIDIA (NVDA-US)、台積電 (TSM-US)及ASML等AI與半導體產業核心企業, 同時也布局基礎模型及AI軟體等領域。若淡馬錫最終直接持有三星電子及SK海力士, 將使其AI硬體布局進一步補上記憶體這一關鍵拼圖。
不過, 投資三星電子與SK海力士也意味著必須承擔AI記憶體景氣循環、地緣政治及中國產能等多重風險。尤其兩家公司在中國均擁有重要生產基地, 面對美國對中國半導體產業的出口管制, 中國廠房未來能否取得設備、零組件與維修服務, 已成為重要不確定因素。
三星電子在西安擁有重要NAND Flash生產基地, 該廠約占三星NAND產量40%; SK海力士則在無錫及大連擁有DRAM及NAND生產基地, 其中無錫廠約占SK海力士DRAM產量30%以上。兩家公司近年反而持續對中國工廠進行升級投資, 顯示中國產能對全球記憶體供應鏈仍具有重要地位。
2025年以來, 美國對三星及SK海力士中國廠取得先進半導體設備的政策持續調整。先前兩家企業中國廠曾享有經驗證最終用戶(VEU)待遇, 之後美國政策改為要求取得年度核准。2025年底, 美國商務部又調整政策, 允許美國製半導體設備在年度核准制度下供應兩家韓企的中國工廠, 但企業仍須面對未來政策進一步變化的風險。

這也是三星電子與SK海力士近期評估中國半導體設備商方案的重要背景。8月初市場傳出, 兩家公司正在測試中國半導體設備, 包括上海中微半導體設備(AMEC)等供應商的產品, 主要目的被認為是為美國若進一步限制西方設備供應或售後服務預留替代方案。這並不代表兩家公司已決定全面以中國設備取代美國、日本或其他西方設備, 而更像是為中國廠房建立第二套供應鏈。相關報導也指出, 目前重點仍在測試設備是否能達到全球領先記憶體產線所需的性能與可靠度。
事實上, 三星與SK海力士並未因地緣政治風險而退出中國。2025年兩家公司合計投入約1.5兆韓元升級中國工廠。三星去年對西安廠投資4,654億韓元, 年增67.5%; SK海力士則在無錫及大連合計投入逾1兆韓元。三星計畫將西安NAND製程由128層升級至236層, SK海力士也持續提升無錫DRAM製程, 並推進大連NAND產線升級。
其中, SK海力士的中國產能更直接與AI記憶體供應鏈相關。TrendForce資料顯示, 中國在2025年約占SK海力士NAND總產量40%至45%, 顯示中國工廠不只是服務中國市場, 也是其全球記憶體供應體系的一部分。
因此, 對淡馬錫而言, 投資韓國記憶體巨頭並不是沒有風險。第一項風險是AI資本支出週期。雖然目前資料中心建設與AI伺服器需求仍強勁, 但如果大型科技企業未來開始放慢資本支出, HBM及高階DRAM需求可能受到影響。
第二項風險則是HBM供應擴張。三星、SK海力士以及美光科技 (MU-US)都在積極擴充AI記憶體產能。當產能擴張速度超過AI伺服器需求增速時, 記憶體價格可能從供不應求快速轉向供給增加, 進而壓縮產業獲利。
第三項風險是中國競爭者。中國記憶體產業持續提升DRAM與NAND自主供應能力, 韓國企業若為降低美國出口管制風險而增加中國設備使用, 一方面可以提高供應鏈韌性, 另一方面也可能加快中國設備商及記憶體產業的技術驗證速度。
但從另一個角度看, 中國市場也正是淡馬錫長期投資策略的重要部分。淡馬錫最新年度報告指出, 其中國底層資產曝險在一年內增加100億新元, 並表示仍將積極投資中國。淡馬錫認為, AI、能源、資料中心及先進製造等長期趨勢, 使中國仍具備相當大的投資機會。
淡馬錫對AI的布局也不僅停留在韓國。其2026年度策略明確將AI列為未來主要投資領域, 並預計到2031年將AI相關資產配置提高至最高15%。這表示淡馬錫並不是押注單一模型、單一晶片或單一市場, 而是試圖沿著整個AI價值鏈建立長期投資組合。
對中國市場而言, 淡馬錫的布局同樣值得關注。原文引用Wind資料顯示, 7月1日至8月4日期間共有178家外資機構參與A股調查, 合計進行421次調查。其中淡馬錫旗下淡馬錫富敦投資有限公司進行10次研究, 頻率位居前列。其關注標的集中於深度參與AI供應鏈的中國硬體企業, 包括深南電路、廣合科技、天孚通信、超穎電子及樂鑫科技等。
這類調研行為與淡馬錫目前的AI投資方向高度吻合。淡馬錫官方表示, AI投資將涵蓋能源、資料中心、半導體、雲端、基礎模型及AI應用與軟體基礎設施, 因此從PCB、高速通信、光通訊元件到AIoT晶片等中國硬體企業, 都可能成為其研究全球AI供應鏈時關注的對象。
值得注意的是, 淡馬錫對中國市場的定位也不只是追求短期估值反彈。公司表示, 中國市場仍是其投資組合中重要的一部分, 並將在全球市場波動加劇的環境下, 透過不同市場與產業配置提高整體投資組合韌性。淡馬錫最新年度報告也強調, 其投資策略著眼於長期結構性趨勢, 而不是短期市場價格波動。
從這個角度看, 淡馬錫若真的在韓國市場直接布局三星電子與SK海力士, 更大的訊號可能不是「抄底韓股」, 而是大型長期資本正在重新評估AI硬體產業的投資週期。
過去兩年AI投資市場的焦點主要集中在GPU、AI模型及大型雲端業者, 但隨著AI資料中心持續擴建, 電力、資料中心、網路設備、先進封裝與高頻寬記憶體的重要性同步上升。淡馬錫將AI投資從目前6%提高至2031年的最高15%, 本身就是對AI基礎設施長期需求仍具有信心的明確訊號。
因此, 韓國記憶體股這波由淡馬錫消息引發的上漲, 雖然短期仍屬市場預期交易, 但背後牽動的卻是更大的AI資本支出與半導體週期問題。三星電子與SK海力士能否將HBM及高階記憶體需求轉化為持續獲利, 同時在中美科技競爭中維持中國產能的運作彈性, 將是這項長期投資邏輯能否成立的關鍵。
對淡馬錫而言, 真正的投資週期可能並非未來幾個月, 而是未來5至10年的AI基礎設施擴張。這也使其傳出考慮直接投資韓國兩大記憶體企業的消息, 超越了單純股價利多的層次: 在AI進入大規模商業化階段後, 掌握記憶體、能源、資料中心與半導體供應鏈的企業, 可能成為AI產業下一階段爭奪定價權的核心。

items.title: 白銀多頭列車要加速！花旗喊上看90美元 潛在漲幅近4成
items.title_en: Silver Bull Train Must Accelerate! Citi Forecasts Up to $90, Potential Gain Near 40%
paras: 花旗最新重申對白銀的看多立場，預估隨著投資買盤接棒成為主要推力，銀價未來 3 個月可望升至每盎司 75 美元，未來 6 至 12 個月更可能挑戰 90 美元，較目前約 65 美元的現貨價格上漲約 38%。
花旗認為，白銀接下來的漲勢將不再主要仰賴工業用途，而是由資金流向主導。隨著荷姆茲海峽緊張局勢最終可望降溫，加上聯準會政策立場可能轉趨溫和，先前壓抑貴金屬的美元走強與實質利率上升等因素有望逐步消退，帶動白銀投資需求持續回升。
由於白銀通常與黃金同向波動，但價格彈性更高。
花旗形容，若荷姆茲海峽僵局迅速化解，白銀將成為押注貴金屬上漲的理想標的。該行基本情境預估，中東局勢最快可能在今年 9 月至 12 月間緩和，屆時白銀有望以更大幅度跟進金價上漲。
另一方面，白銀的工業需求前景開始出現結構性變化。太陽能業者持續減少單位電池的白銀用量，並加快採用背接觸式 (BC) 電池技術，可能使太陽能產業對白銀的需求成長放緩。花旗預估，BC 技術最快可於 2028 年成為太陽能市場的主流技術之一。
不過，人工智慧 (AI)、5G及電動車產業對白銀的需求仍具韌性，花旗預期全球白銀市場至少到 2027 年都將維持供不應求，為銀價提供中長期支撐。
印度市場也是另一項利多。目前印度國內銀價較國際價格溢價約 7%，反映當地買盤強勁。隨著第四季節慶及婚禮旺季到來，印度白銀需求可望進一步升溫。
paras_en: Citi reiterated its bullish stance on silver, estimating that with investment buying taking over as the main driver, the price could rise to $75 per ounce within the next three months and potentially challenge $90 within six to twelve months – about a 38% increase from the current spot price of roughly $65.

Citi believes the upcoming rally in silver will be driven less by industrial use and more by capital flows. As tensions in the Hormuz Strait are expected to ease and the Fed’s policy stance may become more dovish, the previously suppressive factors for precious metals—such as a strong dollar and rising real rates—should gradually recede, reviving investment demand for silver.
Silver typically moves in tandem with gold, but its price is more elastic.

Citi described that if the Hormuz Strait deadlock is resolved quickly, silver would become an ideal vehicle for betting on a rise in precious metals. The bank’s baseline scenario projects that the Middle‑East situation could ease as early as September to December this year, at which point silver is likely to follow gold’s gains with an even larger jump.

On the other hand, the outlook for silver’s industrial demand is beginning to shift structurally. Solar manufacturers are continuously reducing the amount of silver per cell and accelerating the adoption of back‑contact (BC) cell technology, which could slow the growth of silver demand from the solar sector. Citi estimates that BC technology could become one of the mainstream solar technologies as early as 2028.

Nevertheless, demand for silver from AI, 5G and electric‑vehicle industries remains resilient. Citi expects the global silver market to stay in deficit at least through 2027, providing medium‑ to long‑term support for prices.

India also offers a tailwind. Domestic silver prices in India carry a premium of about 7% over international levels, reflecting strong local buying. With the fourth‑quarter festive season and wedding rush approaching, Indian silver demand is expected to heat up further.

items.title: 月底生效！獲MSCI中國指數納入 智譜早盤在港股飆逾6%
items.title_en: Surge over 6%! Zhi Pian included in MSCI China Index, set to take effect on August 31
paras: 港股AI標的智谱今(13)日早盤漲逾6%至每股1297港元，因MSCI在昨日公布的成分股季度審議結果中，將包括智譜在內33檔標的納入MSCI中國指數，智谱與建滔集團為唯二新進港股，另含芯源微、風華高科、大族激光等31檔A股，同時剔除協鑫科技、金力永磁、智飛生物等32檔。上述調整將於8月31日收盤後生效。
由於MSCI中國指數被劃入MSCI新興市場指數與全球標準指數系列，入列即意味獲全球ETF與被動基金跟蹤，預計生效日尾盤將迎來海外資金集中買入。本次新興市場新增成分股市值前三為智谱、南亞科、鼎泰高科。
基本面上，大和證券日前首度給予智譜「買進」評等、目標價1500港元，認為智谱技術迭代正轉化為收入，上月年度雲端經常性收入(ARR)達10億美元，較原定目標提前五個月，集團營收有望由去年7.24億人民幣增至2029年的475億人民幣，年複合成長率185%，2029年毛利率回升至40%並轉虧為盈。
市場解讀，智谱獲納MSCI，加上MaaS商業化提速，讓港股AI基礎模型族群獲指數化配置錨點，但短期股價已反映部分預期，後續仍看token消耗、企業客戶留存與中國國產晶片適配進度。8月31日生效前，被動資金流向與北水態度將成短線觀察重點。
paras_en: Zhi Pian (HK: 1297) surged over 6% to HK$1,297 in early trading today, following MSCI's quarterly review results announced yesterday, which included Zhi Pian among 33 stocks to be added to the MSCI China Index. Zhi Pian and Build King Group are the only two new entrants from Hong Kong, while 31 A-shares, including Xingsource Micro, Windhwa High-tech, and Dahua Laser, were also included. Meanwhile, 32 stocks, including Cooperation Xin, Gold Force Permanent Magnet, and Zhifeng Bio, were removed. The adjustments will take effect after the close on August 31.

As MSCI China Index is included in the MSCI Emerging Markets Index and Global Standard Index series, being included means gaining global ETF and passive fund tracking. It is expected that overseas capital will flow in during the tail end of the trading day on the effective date. The top three stocks in terms of market value among the new additions to the emerging markets index are Zhi Pian, Nansheng Technology, and Ding Tai High-tech.

From a fundamental perspective, Daiwa Securities recently gave Zhi Pian a 'buy' rating, with a target price of HK$1,500. They believe that Zhi Pian's technology iteration is transforming into revenue. The company's annual cloud recurring revenue (ARR) reached US$1 billion in the previous month, five months ahead of the original target. The company's revenue is expected to increase from RMB 7.24 billion last year to RMB 47.5 billion in 2029, with a year-on-year compound growth rate of 185%. The gross margin is expected to rise to 40% in 2029 and turn from a loss to a profit.

Market interpretation is that Zhi Pian's inclusion in the MSCI index, combined with the acceleration of MaaS commercialization, has provided a benchmark for index allocation for the Hong Kong AI base model group. However, the stock price has already reflected part of the expectations, and the subsequent focus will be on token consumption, enterprise customer retention, and China's domestic chip adaptation progress. Before the effective date of August 31, the flow of passive funds and the attitude of northbound capital will be key short-term observations.

items.title: 量產延至2028！三星電機玻璃基板認證受挫 恢復測試至少耗時一年
items.title_en: Mass Production Delayed to 2028! Samsung Electro-Mechanics' Glass Substrate Certification Fails, Recovery Testing to Take at Least a Year
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，三星電機與日本住友化學旗下東友精細化學合資的玻璃基板公司GlaSSEM研發遇挫，送測全球主要通訊半導體廠的TGV(玻璃通孔)樣品未過可靠性認證，原定2027年下半年量產目標推遲至2028年以後，設備採購時程連續跳票數次，產線建設全面停滯。
韓媒《The Elec》近日報導指出問題出在材料與製程，樣品於高低溫循環、濕熱老化測試中出現形變、微孔導通不穩，未達AI算力晶片與CPO光模組封裝門檻。三星電機須重調玻璃配方與TGV鑽孔參數、重做樣品走完客戶全流程復測，業內估算週期至少一年以上。
TGV是下一代先進封裝兵家必爭地，台積電、英特爾、南韓SKC(Absolics)均鎖定2027年前後規模供貨，作為南韓材料龍頭的三星電機突遭延遲，直接擴大短期高端基板缺口。
與此同時，三星電機送樣認證失敗，中國京東方板級試線今年上半年全自動通線，9-2-9/20層樣品過六項信賴性測試並送測封測廠；凱盛科技8吋中試線送樣長電、通富；長信科技造孔與金屬化中試線搭載中；沃格光電1.6T CPO玻璃載板小批供貨，搭配燧原、先封CoPoS方案多輪驗證。
分析人士指出，隨著海外大廠量產延後，中國下游CPO與AI封裝廠將加速導入國產基板，從原片、激光鑽孔、鍍膜到測試配套完整，交期與成本優勢凸顯。
不過，玻璃基板認證週長、脆性與CTE控制難度高，三星踩坑亦是警鐘，中國國內廠商須把長期可靠性數據庫做厚，穩推客戶端批量認證，才抓得牢這道產能空窗期，補齊先進封裝關鍵缺口。
paras_en: According to the latest reports from foreign media, Samsung Electro-Mechanics' joint venture with Japan's Sumitomo Chemical's subsidiary, Toyo Ink SC Holdings, has encountered setbacks in developing its glass substrate company GlaSSEM. The TGV (Glass Via) samples sent to major global communication semiconductor manufacturers failed to pass reliability certification, pushing the originally planned mass production target for the second half of 2027 to 2028 or later. The equipment procurement schedule has been delayed multiple times, and the production line construction has come to a complete standstill.

A recent report by Korean media outlet The Elec states that the problem lies in the materials and processes. The samples showed deformation and unstable micro-hole conductivity during high- and low-temperature cycling and humid heat aging tests, failing to meet the requirements for AI computing power chips and CPO optical module packaging. Samsung Electro-Mechanics must re-adjust the glass formula and TGV drilling parameters, re-make the samples, and go through the entire customer process for re-testing, which is estimated to take at least a year or more.

TGV is a next-generation advanced packaging technology that is highly contested. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC), Intel, and South Korean SKC (Absolics) have all targeted 2027 for large-scale supply. As the leading materials company in South Korea, Samsung Electro-Mechanics' delay has directly expanded the short-term shortage of high-end substrates.

Meanwhile, Samsung Electro-Mechanics' sample certification failure has occurred at the same time as China's Jiangsu Hengtong's 8-inch production line has completed automatic wiring in the first half of the year, with 9-2-9/20-layer samples passing six reliability tests and being sent to the packaging and testing factory. Kaiyuan Technology's 8-inch pilot line has sent samples for long-term testing and wire bonding, while Changxin Technology's hole drilling and metalization pilot line is equipped with a 1.6T CPO glass carrier board for small-batch supply, paired with the Brillian and Xinyu CoPoS scheme for multi-round verification.

Analysts point out that as overseas major manufacturers delay mass production, Chinese downstream CPO and AI packaging factories will accelerate the introduction of domestic substrates, from wafers, laser drilling, and plating to complete testing and packaging, highlighting the advantages of shorter delivery times and lower costs.

However, the difficulty of glass substrate certification, brittleness, and CTE control is high, and Samsung's misstep also serves as a warning. Chinese domestic companies must build a long-term reliability database and stabilize customer-end batch certification to grasp this production window period and fill the key shortage in advanced packaging.

items.title: Anthropic傳砸60億美元買Decart 史上最大收購補強AI算力
items.title_en: Anthropic Spends $6 Billion to Acquire Decart in Largest Acquisition to Date
paras: 彭博引述消息人士報導，Anthropic正洽購同業 Decart AI，交易金額約達 60 億美元，若最終完成，將創下Anthropic迄今規模最大的收購紀錄，也正值其備受市場矚目的IPO前夕。
向來極少進行大型併購的 Anthropic，為了開發新產品與服務客戶，近年持續在算力上投入重金。
消息人士表示，Decart 的軟體能使晶片運作更具效率，進而降低訓練人工智慧模型的成本。這項技術有助於 Anthropic 現有基礎設施承載更龐大的需求。交易完成後，Decart 的團隊將加入 Anthropic 的推論與效能部門。
Decart 同時專注於生成式影片技術，利用所謂的「世界模型」（world models），即時修改直播影像。消息人士指出，這項技術也反映 Decart 擁有高水準的基礎設施技術人才。
Anthropic 與 Decart 的代表均拒絕置評。
Decart 今年 5 月表示，公司在由 Radical Ventures 領投的一輪融資中籌得 3 億美元，輝達(NVDA-US) 、Atreides Management、Valor Equity Partners 與 Adobe Ventures 也參與投資。既有投資人紅杉資本、Benchmark 與 Zeev Ventures 同樣參與本輪融資。
據《華爾街日報》報導，該輪融資對這家新創公司的估值逼近 40 億美元，高於 2025 年 8 月時的 31 億美元。
Decart 成立於 2023 年，由三名以色列工程師共同創辦，分別是兄弟 Dean Leitersdorf、Orian Leitersdorf，以及 Moshe Shalev。
OpenAI 與 Anthropic 都已承諾投入數百億、甚至數千億美元，興建配置昂貴晶片的資料中心。隨著運算需求急速攀升，兩家公司也愈來愈依賴不同供應商提供的硬體，以滿足龐大的算力需求。
隨著這兩家 AI 新創公司準備在未來幾個月內迎來華爾街首秀，這些被其高層認為是打造與支援尖端人工智慧模型不可或缺的龐大支出，也可能為其帶來財務壓力。
本篇不開放合作媒體轉載
paras_en: Bloomberg reported that Anthropic is in talks to acquire Decart AI, with a deal valued at around $6 billion, which would be the company's largest acquisition to date, coming at a time when it is preparing for its highly anticipated IPO.
Anthropic, which has historically been reluctant to make large acquisitions, has been investing heavily in computing power in recent years to develop new products and serve its customers.

According to sources, Decart's software enables chips to operate more efficiently, reducing the cost of training artificial intelligence models. This technology will help Anthropic's existing infrastructure handle larger demands.

Decart has also focused on generative video technology, using so-called 'world models' to modify live video in real-time. Sources say this technology reflects Decart's high level of infrastructure technology talent.
Representatives from Anthropic and Decart declined to comment.

Decart announced in May that it had raised $300 million in a funding round led by Radical Ventures, with NVIDIA (NVDA-US), Atreides Management, Valor Equity Partners, and Adobe Ventures also participating. Existing investors Redpoint Ventures, Benchmark, and Zeev Ventures also participated in the round.
According to a report by The Wall Street Journal, the funding round valued the company at around $4 billion, higher than its $3.1 billion valuation in August 2025.
Decart was founded in 2023 by three Israeli engineers, Dean Leitersdorf, Orian Leitersdorf, and Moshe Shalev.

Both OpenAI and Anthropic have committed to investing hundreds of billions, if not trillions, of dollars in building data centers equipped with expensive chips. As computing demands have skyrocketed, both companies have increasingly relied on hardware suppliers to meet their massive computing needs.

As these two AI startups prepare to go public on Wall Street in the coming months, these massive expenditures, which their executives believe are essential for building and supporting cutting-edge AI models, may also bring financial pressure.

items.title: 硬體股大幅跑贏標普500！高盛最看好這三家公司
items.title_en: Hardware Stocks Outperform the S&P 500! Goldman Sachs’ Top Three Picks
paras: 人工智慧 (AI) 基礎建設投資持續升溫，高盛最新點名戴爾科技、慧與科技及NetApp為美國硬體產業三大首選股。高盛認為，AI伺服器需求快速成長，加上企業加速更新資料中心設備，可望繼續推升硬體業者營收與獲利。
美國硬體股今年第二季以來明顯跑贏大盤。高盛統計，4月1日至8月7日期間，標普500指數上漲18%，IT硬體類股上漲136%，戴爾科技、慧與科技與NetApp的漲幅則分別達168%、122%及86%。
高盛維持三家公司「買進」評等，但依據最新營運展望分別調整目標價，其中戴爾科技仍是首選。
戴爾科技：AI與傳統伺服器需求同步成長
高盛維持戴爾科技 (DELL-US)「買進」評等，並將12個月目標價由500美元調高至510美元。除了AI伺服器需求強勁，傳統伺服器業務展望改善，也是高盛上調財測的主要原因。
高盛預估，戴爾2027會計年度第二季營收將達448億美元，其中基礎設施解決方案事業群營收可望年增75%，用戶端解決方案事業群也將成長20%。調整後每股盈餘預估為4.96美元，高於公司財測區間上緣。
基於傳統伺服器營收預期上修，高盛將戴爾2027至2029會計年度每股盈餘預測平均調高4%。戴爾近期也推出搭載輝達 (NVDA-US) Vera Rubin架構的PowerEdge XE8812伺服器，進一步強化AI硬體產品布局。
不過，高盛提醒，個人電腦需求轉弱、企業IT支出放緩、同業價格競爭、零組件成本上升，以及白牌伺服器業者搶占市占率，可能對戴爾的成長與利潤率造成壓力。
慧與科技：網路設備成為另一成長引擎
高盛同樣維持慧與科技 (HPE-US)「買進」評等，但將12個月目標價由79美元下修至75美元。
高盛預估，慧與科技2026會計年度第三季營收將達120億美元，高於市場共識，其中雲端與AI業務營收可望年增22%，網路業務更可能大增77%。調整後每股盈餘預估為0.94美元，略高於公司財測區間上緣。
隨著超大規模雲端服務商擴建AI基礎設施，加上一般用途運算需求加速回升，高盛將慧與科技2026至2028會計年度每股盈餘預估平均上調2%，主要反映網路設備營收展望改善。
慧與科技近期獲得雲端服務商Vultr選用，參與大規模AI資料中心部署，並把Juniper Networks網路產品整合至AI資料中心解決方案，同時與8家公司擴大在量子運算領域的合作。
潛在風險則包括企業IT支出下滑、白牌設備競爭、整合Juniper期間流失市占率，以及零組件成本上升。
NetApp：企業儲存設備售價支撐成長
高盛維持資料儲存業者NetApp (NTAP-US)「買進」評等，並將12個月目標價由200美元調高至210美元，主要看好企業基礎設施支出，以及儲存設備平均售價上升。
高盛預估，NetApp 2027會計年度第一季營收將達18.1億美元，每股盈餘為2.12美元，略高於公司財測中間值。基於儲存設備平均售價提高，高盛將2027至2029會計年度營收與每股盈餘預測分別平均上調5%及4%。
NetApp上一季營收與獲利均優於市場預期，帶動Argus與巴克萊等機構調高目標價。公司近期也宣布收購AI資料基礎設施業者DataPelago，以擴充AI資料管理能力。
高盛提醒，NetApp仍可能面臨供應短缺、企業本地部署儲存設備需求長期下滑、產業競爭加劇，以及全球總體經濟轉弱等風險。
paras_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure investment continues to heat up, and Goldman Sachs has recently highlighted Dell Technologies, Hewlett Packard Enterprise and NetApp as the three top U.S. hardware stocks. Goldman Sachs believes that rapid growth in AI server demand, combined with enterprises accelerating data‑center upgrades, should keep driving revenue and profit growth for hardware makers.

U.S. hardware stocks have clearly outperformed the broader market since the second quarter of this year. Goldman Sachs calculated that from April 1 to August 7, the S&P 500 rose 18%, while IT hardware stocks jumped 136%, with Dell Technologies, Hewlett Packard Enterprise and NetApp gaining 168%, 122% and 86% respectively.
Goldman Sachs maintains a “Buy” rating on all three companies but has adjusted their target prices based on the latest operating outlook, keeping Dell Technologies as the top pick.
Dell Technologies: AI and Traditional Server Demand Growing Together

Goldman Sachs keeps a “Buy” rating on Dell Technologies (DELL‑US) and raises its 12‑month target price from $500 to $510. In addition to strong AI server demand, an improving outlook for the traditional server business is the main reason for the upgraded financial forecasts.

Goldman Sachs estimates that Dell’s fiscal 2027 second‑quarter revenue will reach $44.8 billion, with the infrastructure solutions segment expected to grow 75% year‑over‑year and the client solutions segment to expand 20%. Adjusted earnings per share are projected at $4.96, above the upper end of the company’s own guidance range.

Based on the upward revision to traditional server revenue, Goldman Sachs lifts its average EPS forecast for Dell for fiscal 2027‑2029 by 4%. Dell recently introduced the PowerEdge XE8812 server built on Nvidia’s (NVDA‑US) Vera Rubin architecture, further strengthening its AI hardware portfolio.

However, Goldman Sachs cautions that weakening PC demand, slower enterprise IT spending, competitive pricing pressure, rising component costs and white‑label server vendors gaining market share could pressure Dell’s growth and margins.
Hewlett Packard Enterprise: Network Gear Becomes Another Growth Engine
Goldman Sachs also maintains a “Buy” rating on Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE‑US) but cuts its 12‑month target price from $79 to $75.

Goldman Sachs projects that HPE’s fiscal 2026 third‑quarter revenue will reach $12 billion, above market consensus, with cloud and AI revenues expected to grow 22% annually and networking revenues potentially surging 77%. Adjusted EPS is estimated at $0.94, slightly above the top of the company’s guidance range.

With hyperscale cloud providers expanding AI infrastructure and general‑purpose compute demand rebounding, Goldman Sachs raises its average EPS forecast for HPE for fiscal 2026‑2028 by 2%, reflecting an improved outlook for networking equipment revenue.

HPE recently won a deal with cloud provider Vultr to participate in large‑scale AI data‑center deployments, integrated Juniper Networks networking products into its AI data‑center solutions, and expanded collaborations with eight firms in the quantum‑computing space.
Potential risks include a slowdown in enterprise IT spending, competition from white‑label equipment, market‑share loss during Juniper integration, and rising component costs.
NetApp: Enterprise Storage Prices Support Growth

Goldman Sachs keeps a “Buy” rating on data‑storage company NetApp (NTAP‑US) and raises its 12‑month target price from $200 to $210, mainly due to confidence in enterprise infrastructure spending and rising average selling prices for storage gear.

Goldman Sachs estimates NetApp’s fiscal 2027 first‑quarter revenue at $1.81 billion, with EPS of $2.12, slightly above the company’s midpoint guidance. Based on higher average storage‑equipment prices, it lifts its revenue and EPS forecasts for fiscal 2027‑2029 by an average of 5% and 4% respectively.

NetApp’s last quarter revenue and profit both beat market expectations, prompting firms such as Argus and Barclays to raise their target prices. The company also announced the acquisition of AI data‑infrastructure provider DataPelago to expand its AI data‑management capabilities.

Goldman Sachs warns that NetApp could still face supply shortages, a long‑term decline in on‑premises storage demand, intensifying industry competition, and a weakening global macro‑economic environment.

items.title: 特斯拉大招來了！馬斯克：未來特斯拉所有車輛都將導入星鏈 唯中國市場仍有變數
items.title_en: Tesla to Integrate Starlink into All Vehicles, with Exceptions
paras: 特斯拉(TSLA-US)執行長馬斯克近期宣布, 未來特斯拉旗下所有車款都將整合SpaceX旗下星鏈(Starlink)衛星網路, 但目前僅確定適用於星鏈已提供服務的市場, 尚未公布全面導入的具體時間表。馬斯克表示, 隨著Robotaxi擴大部署, 車輛不能因蜂窩網路死角而失去連線, 星鏈將成為重要的備援與高速連網方案。
馬斯克是在特斯拉第2季財報電話會議上談到與SpaceX合作時透露這項規劃。他表示, 星鏈目前正在整合至Cybercab, 未來也會整合到所有特斯拉車輛, 「至少是在星鏈已經啟用的市場」。馬斯克解釋, Robotaxi需要在各個地點維持連線, 即使是在矽谷, 仍存在蜂窩網路訊號不佳甚至完全沒有訊號的區域, 因此不能讓無人計程車卡在這些「蜂窩網路死角」中。
這項規劃近期再度受到關注, 原因是特斯拉本周公開展示首輛整合星鏈的Cybercab。特斯拉8月10日發布照片, 顯示星鏈設備已直接整合至Cybercab車頂結構, 不再需要外掛大型衛星天線。馬斯克隨後表示, Cybercab乘客可以在車內觀看4K直播、電影、玩遊戲或進行生產力工作, 顯示星鏈除了支援車輛本身的通訊需求, 也可能成為Robotaxi的車內娛樂及Wi-Fi基礎設施。
Cybercab被視為星鏈車載化的第一個重要測試案例。相關技術資訊顯示, 星鏈終端被嵌入Cybercab車頂, 以降低外露設備對車體外觀及空氣動力設計的影響。特斯拉AI主管Ashok Elluswamy此前也指出, 衛星網路並非自動駕駛本身的必要條件, 主要用途是提供導航、車隊管理以及偏遠地區的備援連線。
對特斯拉而言, 星鏈最大的價值並不只是讓乘客在車內上網, 而是為Robotaxi建立更具韌性的通信網路。現有蜂窩網路仍可能受到地形、人口密度、基地台覆蓋以及道路位置影響, 自駕車若在高速公路、偏遠地區或其他訊號較弱的區域失去與雲端及車隊管理系統的通信, 將增加營運難度。
馬斯克在財報會議上甚至提出更進一步的構想, 認為安裝在特斯拉車輛上的星鏈終端未來可能作為地面上的「連線中繼」或類似基地台的節點, 為附近手機及其他裝置提供Wi-Fi或網路連線。這顯示特斯拉可能不只是把Starlink視為單一車輛的網路設備, 而是希望把大量汽車轉化成分散式通信節點。
不過, 「所有特斯拉都會有星鏈」與「所有特斯拉都能立即使用星鏈」並不是同一件事。馬斯克目前的說法明確加上「星鏈已啟用的市場」這項限制, 代表衛星網路的監管許可、服務覆蓋及當地通信政策, 都會影響實際落地速度。特斯拉目前也沒有公布哪些既有車款可以透過升級硬體取得星鏈, 或是否會提供舊車加裝方案。
此外, 車載星鏈的成本也是大規模普及必須面對的問題。星鏈目前不同市場及方案的價格差異很大, 官方服務方案顯示, 部分Roam服務價格約從每月50美元起, 無限流量方案則可達每月105美元; 其他市場的方案價格也可能達到每月160美元以上。這些價格主要是現有Starlink服務方案, 並非特斯拉已公布的車載星鏈售價, 因此不能直接視為未來特斯拉車主必須支付的月費。
更重要的是, 特斯拉目前並沒有公布星鏈車載服務是否會納入車輛售價、是否需要額外訂閱, 或由特斯拉統一負擔服務費用。若未來每輛車都配備衛星終端, 硬體成本、電力消耗、衛星網路服務費及維護成本都可能成為特斯拉需要處理的新增支出。
星鏈本身也不是在所有環境下都能取代蜂窩網路。衛星通信高度依賴車輛與天空之間的可視條件, 高樓、隧道、地下停車場、山區以及茂密樹林等環境都可能造成遮蔽。2026年的研究也指出, 星鏈在移動環境中會因視線受阻及訊號品質變化而進行動態衛星切換, 當連線品質下降時, 網路效能可能受到影響。
換句話說, 星鏈更可能是蜂窩網路的補充, 而非全面取代4G或5G。對一般城市通勤而言, 蜂窩網路仍具有成本低、覆蓋成熟及室內穿透等優勢; 對Robotaxi而言, Starlink則可在蜂窩網路不足的地點提供額外的通信冗餘, 降低車隊因失聯而無法正常營運的風險。
特斯拉目前在台灣提供的車輛連線服務仍以既有的標準及頂級連線功能為主, 官方列出的功能包括導航、即時路況、衛星檢視地圖、哨兵模式遠端查看、音樂串流、影片串流及網路瀏覽器等, 部分功能可透過Wi-Fi使用。官方目前並未在台灣連線服務頁面宣布星鏈車載服務。
中國市場的情況則更加複雜。星鏈目前並未在中國大陸提供一般消費者衛星網路服務, 因此即使特斯拉未來將星鏈硬體整合進車輛, 也不代表中國大陸車主能直接啟用服務。中國工業和信息化部已陸續向中國電信、中國聯通及中國移動核發衛星移動通信業務經營許可, 可依法開展手機直連衛星等服務, 但這與星鏈在中國大陸提供完整車載衛星寬頻服務仍是不同的監管與商業問題。
因此, 中國大陸特斯拉車主能否使用星鏈, 關鍵並不只是車輛有沒有安裝衛星天線, 還涉及星鏈是否取得當地服務所需的監管許可、頻譜與通信資質, 以及特斯拉是否針對中國市場推出相應方案。目前沒有證據顯示特斯拉已公布中國大陸市場的星鏈商業化時間表。
星鏈車載化的背景, 也與馬斯克旗下企業近年更加緊密的協同有關。特斯拉目前已在車輛中導入SpaceX旗下AI系統Grok, SpaceX則採購特斯拉Megapack及車輛, 雙方並推動Terafab晶片工廠等合作。隨著Starlink進入Cybercab, 馬斯克旗下企業之間的技術及商業整合程度進一步提高。
這項整合對Robotaxi尤其重要。特斯拉正在把Cybercab視為未來自駕車服務的核心產品, 而無人車隊與一般私人乘用車最大的差異之一, 就是車輛需要持續接受車隊調度、導航資訊、軟體更新及遠端管理。雖然自動駕駛主要依賴車內感測器與運算能力, 並不代表每個駕駛決策都需要透過網路完成, 但穩定通信可以提高車隊營運效率及故障處理能力。
因此, 馬斯克宣布所有車輛最終導入星鏈, 更值得關注的其實是特斯拉未來汽車的定位正在改變。汽車不再只是依靠4G或5G連網的終端, 而可能成為具備衛星通信能力的移動網路節點, 並與Robotaxi、AI、車隊管理及車內娛樂服務形成新的生態系。
對星鏈而言, 特斯拉則可能成為一個規模龐大的車載終端市場。SpaceX近期持續擴大星鏈商業版圖, 星鏈已成為SpaceX重要的營收來源。隨著車載、航空、海事及手機直連衛星等服務持續擴張, 星鏈的定位也逐漸從偏遠地區寬頻服務商, 向更廣泛的全球通信基礎設施平台轉型。
不過, 特斯拉目前尚未公布全系車款導入星鏈的具體時間、硬體規格、服務價格及既有車輛升級方案。因此, 現階段最確定的訊息是Cybercab已開始整合星鏈, 而馬斯克已在財報會議上明確表示, 未來所有特斯拉車輛都將導入星鏈, 但前提是所在市場已有星鏈服務。
對消費者而言, 真正值得等待的並不是「特斯拉會不會裝星鏈」, 而是特斯拉最後會如何定價、哪些車型先導入、舊車能否升級, 以及星鏈究竟會成為免費的基礎連線功能, 還是另一項需要車主額外付費的訂閱服務。這些細節目前都仍未揭曉。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) CEO Elon Musk recently announced that all future Tesla models will be integrated with SpaceX's Starlink satellite network, but only in markets where Starlink is already available. Musk stated that as Robotaxi expands, vehicles cannot afford to lose connection due to cellular network dead zones, and Starlink will serve as a crucial backup and high-speed internet solution.

Musk revealed this plan during Tesla's Q2 earnings call, stating that Starlink is being integrated into Cybercab and will eventually be integrated into all Tesla vehicles, 'at least in markets where Starlink is already available.' Musk explained that Robotaxi needs to maintain connectivity in various locations, even in areas with poor or no cellular signal, and cannot be hindered by 'cellular dead zones.'

This plan has garnered attention recently due to Tesla's public showcase of the first Cybercab with integrated Starlink. On August 10, Tesla released photos showing Starlink equipment directly integrated into the Cybercab's roof structure, eliminating the need for external satellite antennas. Musk later stated that Cybercab passengers can watch 4K live streams, movies, play games, or work inside the vehicle, demonstrating Starlink's potential to support in-vehicle entertainment and Wi-Fi infrastructure.

Cybercab is seen as the first significant test case for Starlink's vehicle integration. Technical information reveals that Starlink terminals are embedded in the Cybercab's roof to minimize the impact of external devices on the vehicle's design and aerodynamics. Tesla's AI chief, Ashok Elluswamy, previously noted that satellite networks are not a necessary condition for autonomous driving but are primarily used for navigation, fleet management, and backup connectivity in remote areas.

For Tesla, Starlink's greatest value lies not only in providing passengers with in-vehicle internet but also in establishing a more resilient communication network for Robotaxi. Existing cellular networks can still be affected by terrain, population density, base station coverage, and road location, and self-driving cars that lose connection with the cloud and fleet management systems in areas with weak signals will face operational difficulties.

Musk even proposed a more advanced concept during the earnings call, suggesting that Starlink terminals installed in Tesla vehicles could serve as 'connection relays' or base station-like nodes, providing Wi-Fi or internet connectivity to nearby devices. This indicates that Tesla may not only view Starlink as a single-vehicle network device but also as a means to transform a large number of vehicles into decentralized communication nodes.

However, 'all Teslas will have Starlink' and 'all Teslas can immediately use Starlink' are not the same thing. Musk's current statement explicitly adds the limitation of 'markets where Starlink is already available,' implying that regulatory approvals, service coverage, and local communication policies will impact the actual rollout speed. Tesla has not announced which existing models can be upgraded to support Starlink or if there will be an upgrade program for older vehicles.

Additionally, the cost of vehicle-integrated Starlink is a significant issue that must be addressed for large-scale adoption. Starlink's prices vary greatly across different markets and plans, with some Roam services starting at around $50 per month and unlimited data plans reaching up to $105 per month. These prices are for existing Starlink services and not the announced prices for Tesla's vehicle-integrated Starlink, so they cannot be directly taken as the monthly fees that future Tesla owners will have to pay.

More importantly, Tesla has not disclosed whether the Starlink vehicle service will be included in the vehicle's purchase price, require a separate subscription, or be covered by Tesla's service fees. If every vehicle is equipped with a satellite terminal in the future, hardware costs, power consumption, satellite network service fees, and maintenance costs could all become new expenses for Tesla to handle.

Starlink is not a replacement for cellular networks in all environments. Satellite communication heavily relies on the line of sight between the vehicle and the sky, and environments like high-rise buildings, tunnels, underground parking lots, mountainous areas, and dense forests can cause obstruction. Research in 2026 also pointed out that Starlink may perform dynamic satellite switching in mobile environments due to blocked lines of sight and changing signal quality, which can affect network performance when connection quality degrades.

In other words, Starlink is more likely to complement cellular networks rather than fully replace 4G or 5G. For general urban commutes, cellular networks still have the advantages of low cost, mature coverage, and indoor penetration; for Robotaxi, Starlink can provide additional communication redundancy in areas where cellular networks are insufficient, reducing the risk of fleet operation disruptions due to lost connections.

Tesla currently offers vehicle connectivity services in Taiwan, focusing on standard and premium connectivity features, including navigation, real-time traffic, satellite map view, remote monitoring, music streaming, video streaming, and web browsing, with some features accessible via Wi-Fi. However, Tesla has not announced Starlink vehicle services on its Taiwan connectivity page.

The situation in the Chinese market is more complex. Starlink has not been made available to general consumers in mainland China, so even if Tesla integrates Starlink hardware into vehicles in the future, it does not mean that Chinese mainland car owners can directly activate the service. China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology has issued licenses for satellite mobile communication services to Chinese telecom operators, but this is a different regulatory and commercial issue than Starlink providing full vehicle-mounted satellite broadband services in China.

Therefore, whether Chinese mainland Tesla owners can use Starlink depends not only on the vehicle being equipped with a satellite antenna but also on whether Starlink obtains the necessary regulatory approvals, spectrum, and communication qualifications for local services, as well as whether Tesla launches corresponding plans for the Chinese market. There is currently no evidence that Tesla has announced a commercialization timeline for Starlink in the Chinese mainland market.

The background of Starlink's vehicle integration is also related to the increasingly close cooperation between Musk's companies in recent years. Tesla has introduced SpaceX's AI system, Grok, into its vehicles, while SpaceX has purchased Tesla's Megapack and vehicles, and both are promoting cooperation on the Terafab chip factory. As Starlink enters Cybercab, the degree of technological and business integration between Musk's companies has further increased.

This integration is particularly important for Robotaxi. Tesla views Cybercab as the core product for future self-driving car services, and the biggest difference between autonomous fleets and private vehicles is the need for continuous reception of fleet scheduling, navigation information, software updates, and remote management. Although autonomous driving primarily relies on in-vehicle sensors and computing capabilities, stable communication can enhance fleet operation efficiency and fault handling capability.

Thus, Musk's announcement that all vehicles will eventually integrate Starlink is more noteworthy because it signifies a change in the positioning of Tesla's future cars. Cars are no longer just 4G or 5G connected terminals but may become mobile network nodes with satellite communication capabilities, forming a new ecosystem with Robotaxi, AI, fleet management, and in-vehicle entertainment services.

For Starlink, Tesla could become a vast market for vehicle-mounted terminals. SpaceX has been expanding Starlink's commercial footprint, and Starlink has become an important source of revenue for SpaceX. As vehicle, aviation, maritime, and direct-to-phone satellite services continue to expand, Starlink's positioning is gradually shifting from a remote area broadband service provider to a more comprehensive global communication infrastructure platform.

However, Tesla has not disclosed the specific timeline, hardware specifications, service prices, or upgrade plans for existing vehicles to integrate Starlink across its entire lineup. Therefore, the most confirmed information at this stage is that Cybercab has begun integrating Starlink, and Musk has stated that all future Tesla vehicles will have Starlink, but only in markets where the service is already available.

For consumers, what is truly worth waiting for is not 'whether Tesla will install Starlink' but how Tesla will price the service, which models will be integrated first, whether older cars can be upgraded, and whether Starlink will become a free basic connectivity feature or another subscription service that car owners need to pay for. These details remain unannounced.

items.title: 騰訊年底GPU儲備「非常充足」、輝達徹底缺位：中國AI算力市場一夜換主人
items.title_en: Tencent’s Year‑End GPU Stock “Very Ample”, Nvidia Completely Absent: China’s AI Compute Market Switches Hands Overnight
paras: 中國騰訊雲最新財報顯示，該公司正持續推進自主算力佈局，預計年底至明年初GPU資源儲備將達「非常充足」狀態，以支撐雲端服務擴容與大模型研發。騰訊將統籌調度全平台算力，兼顧內部自用與對外出租，最大化資源利用率。
隨著輝達受美國出口管制影響，該公司在中國先進AI加速器市場市佔率從近95%驟降至接近零，等於完全退出高端AI算力賽道，這一巨大缺口正由華為、摩爾線程等國產晶片廠商迅速補位，迎來前所未有的發展期。
此消彼長之間，中鶻ㄛ國產AI晶片正加速迭代與規模交付，市佔率穩步攀升。市場觀察指出，這不僅是供應鏈的替代，更是中國AI基礎設施自主化進程的關鍵轉捩點，從「輝達單極壟斷」轉向「多廠商協同共生」的新格局。
儘管部分中國國產晶片在性能上仍落後於輝達頂級產品，但中國大模型廠商透過深度協同優化，已能在實際場景中有效彌補參數差距，加上國產方案普遍具備更穩定的電力保障與本地化服務優勢，華為近期推出的超節點算力解決方案即為典型代表。
paras_en: Tencent Cloud’s latest financial report shows the company is continuously advancing its own compute‑power deployment and expects its GPU resource stockpile to be “very ample” by the end of the year into early next year, supporting cloud‑service expansion and large‑model development. Tencent will centrally schedule compute across all platforms, balancing internal use and external leasing to maximize utilization.

As Nvidia is hit by U.S. export controls, its share of China’s advanced AI accelerator market has plummeted from nearly 95% to almost zero, effectively exiting the high‑end AI compute arena. This huge gap is being rapidly filled by domestic chip makers such as Huawei and Moore Threads, ushering in an unprecedented growth phase.

In this shift, Chinese‑made AI chips are accelerating iteration and large‑scale delivery, with market share steadily climbing. Observers note that this is not merely a supply‑chain substitution but a pivotal turning point in China’s drive for autonomous AI infrastructure, moving from a “Nvidia‑centric monopoly” to a “multi‑vendor collaborative ecosystem.”

Although some Chinese chips still lag behind Nvidia’s top products in performance, Chinese large‑model firms, through deep co‑optimization, can effectively bridge the parameter gap in real‑world scenarios. Coupled with the generally more stable power supply and localized service advantages of domestic solutions, Huawei’s recently launched ultra‑node compute solution exemplifies this trend.

items.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro上線 性能逼近Fable 5 價格只有它的2%
paras: DeepSeek V4 Pro正式版於周三(12日)上線。目前DeepSeek未發布推文，唯一跡象是官網API定價頁面上的一行字變了，「deepseek-v4-pro」後面的版本號從預覽版變為DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813。
這也意味著從2026年4月起以預覽版形式提供服務的旗艦模型，終於正式轉正。
據了解，DeepSeek V4 Pro是一個混合專家（MoE）模型，總參數量達到1.6兆，每個token激活490億參數，上下文窗口為100萬token，最大可以輸出38.4萬token，這個規模放在全球AI模型中位居第一梯隊。此前第三方測試主要使用預覽版本，相關模型在Hugging Face等平台已有大量下載。
正式版上線後的價格與非高峰時段價格保持一致。這一價格其實就是2026年5月永久降價至原價四分之一後的標準價格，具體來說，每百萬輸入token收費0.435美元，輸出收費0.87美元，緩存命中的輸入收費只需要0.003625美元。
相比之下，Anthropic的Claude Fable 5每百萬輸入token收費10美元，輸出收費50美元。以輸出token價格計算，兩者相差近58倍，DeepSeek V4 Pro的價格還不到Claude Fable 5的2%。
要是按完成單個任務的成本來算，差距可能更加明顯。有機構測試過，使用Claude Fable 5完成一個基準任務花費3.15美元，使用DeepSeek V4 Flash只需花費3美分，兩者相差100倍。DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813版本的單任務成本目前還缺乏充分的第三方測試，但由於目前API價格體系沒有變化，實際成本差距仍可能相當可觀。
之所以價格差距能拉這麼大，主要與架構設計有關。DeepSeek V4 Pro使用了兩種注意力變體，分別是壓縮稀疏注意力（Compressed Sparse Attention）和重度壓縮注意力（Heavily Compressed Attention）。
按照DeepSeek的說法，這套架構能夠把單token推理計算量降至V3.2的27%，KV緩存則降至原來的10%。這對於100萬token的上下文窗口來說，能夠節省的成本相當可觀。由於推理效率提高，也為模型提供了更大的定價空間。
DeepSeek自己也進行了基準測試，在10項智能體評測中與Claude Fable 5進行比較。去掉差距最大的一項之後（Humanity"s Last Exam，DeepSeek V4 Pro落後10.6個百分點），剩下9項中DeepSeek平均落後2.8%，其中有2項DeepSeek勝出。
不過，這些數據是DeepSeek自行測試的結果，使用的是自家尚未對外開放的評測框架，而且相關內部測試集也沒有公開榜單可以驗證。因此，DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813版本的實際表現，仍有待第三方評測進一步確認。上述數據目前只能說明DeepSeek認為V4 Pro在部分測試中已接近Claude Fable 5，尚不能直接視為兩者整體性能相當。
DeepSeek V4 Pro在API中提供不同程度的推理模式，包括非思考及不同推理強度的設定。其中，較高的推理模式可以進一步提升模型的推理能力。API同時支援OpenAI和Anthropic兩種格式的接口，先前已在這兩個生態系統中開發的開發者無需大幅修改程式碼即可切換使用，同時支援工具調用、結構化JSON輸出等功能。
DeepSeek V4 Pro正式版上線後，DeepSeek V4系列的產品結構變得更加清晰：一方面，Flash版本負責高頻、高併發的使用場景，主打低價格；Pro版本則將更多算力集中在複雜推理、長上下文編碼及智能體任務上。部分AI開發公司已開始搭配使用兩種版本。
不過，DeepSeek的定價頁面也已預告，近期將進行一次「顯著的價格調整」。至於具體漲幅以及何時調整，目前尚未公布，因此目前這個低價窗口還能維持多久，仍有待觀察。
同時，多家聚合平台的數據顯示，2026年7月DeepSeek模型的Token調用規模已位居全球AI模型第一梯隊，在部分榜單中僅次於Anthropic的模型。DeepSeek的業務增長主要依託開發者的實際API調用，迄今為止也沒有舉辦大型媒體發布會，主要透過公眾號宣布產品消息，有時也會發布技術博客。
眾所周知，DeepSeek的算力儲備相較海外AI頭部企業並不算大。根據7月流出的投資人交流會內容，梁文鋒曾提到，當時DeepSeek擁有約2萬張H100等效算力。這個數字與海外AI頭部大廠動輒幾十萬甚至上百萬張GPU的集群相比，確實不在同一個量級。
不過，梁文鋒也表示這個數字是動態的，DeepSeek一直在努力採購更多算力，並計畫「在合理價格內能買多少卡就買多少卡」。與此同時，DeepSeek據報也在規劃GW級的自建算力基礎設施，近期針對內蒙古資料中心相關職位的招聘，也被外界視為其擴充算力布局的跡象。
DeepSeek還與華為合作。根據流出的投資人交流會內容，DeepSeek獲得華為約1.6萬張昇騰950算力卡的配置，用於軟體生態驗證與落地。另有第三方機構已在中國國產算力集群（昇騰910C）上完成DeepSeek V4 Pro的全參數後訓練，這顯示國產算力正在逐步承擔更重的AI模型訓練任務。
目前DeepSeek V4系列採用MIT授權的開放權重模式。至於DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813正式版權重的公開進度，仍需以官方後續公告為準。按照V4 Flash「API先跑、權重隨後跟上」的節奏，市場仍在等待正式版權重的進一步消息。
第三方評測機構目前也正在陸續測試DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813版本。待更多獨立評測數據公布後，才能更清楚判斷DeepSeek V4 Pro這次的性能提升幅度，以及它與Claude Fable 5等頂級模型之間的實際差距。

items.title: 【遠東商銀】美國CPI如預期，美元小幅上漲
paras: ◆USD/JPY

美國7月成屋銷售連續兩個月下跌，但小企業信心指數升至十一個月高點，並據美國和葉門親伊朗的胡塞武裝分別報告對航運的襲擊及北韓發射導彈的消息，週三令亞洲市場不安，並關注美國消費者價格指數(CPI)數據，尋找美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)可能升息的線索，支撐美元持穩，但8月路透短觀調查顯示，受惠於強勁半導體需求，日本製造業景氣判斷指數創3月以來最高達正18，同時因國內消費強勁，非製造業景氣判斷指數升至正28，並據東京短資數據，日本央行(BOJ)在9月加息的概率已升至78%，而且中東局勢再添不確定性，推升原油價格及加劇通貨膨脹擔憂，促使五年期日本公債收益率創歷史新高，對政策利率最敏感的兩年期日本公債收益率亦升至1995年5月以來最高，提供日圓支撐。

隨後美國公布7月消費者物價指數(CPI)分別較前月與上年同期漲0.1%及3.4%符合預期，但扣除食品和能源成分的核心CPI較去年同期降至2.5%，通貨膨脹連續兩個月降溫，促使芝加哥商品交易所(CME)的FedWatch工具顯示FED在9月15-16日會議升息的機率跌至38%，打擊美元兌日圓至158.67低點。隨著英國金融時報報導，美國波士頓聯邦儲備銀行柯林斯表示若通貨膨脹率居高不下，支持FED在9月加息，而且細項數據來看，美國通貨膨脹壓力有擴散跡象及FED青睞的個人消費支出(PCE)物價指標料仍維持3%，推升美元兌日圓至159.54高點。預估今日美元兌日圓支撐於158.80-159.00，阻力於159.70-90。
◆EUR/USD
澳洲央行(RBA)維持利率在4.35%不變，但總裁布洛克在新聞發布會上釋放更鷹派訊號表示，若通貨膨脹未能如預期般回落，完全有可能再升息，突顯10月底公布第三季CPI數據的重要性，而且市場預計FED於9月加息的概率約50%，相對RBA於11月再收緊貨幣政策的可能性大致相當，昨日支撐澳幣和紐元，帶動歐元兌美元觸及1.1562高點。

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元抹去CPI數據後跌幅 荷姆茲海峽局勢不明推升避險需求
paras: 美元周三(12日)從盤中低點反彈並小幅走升，中東和平協議的不確定性，抵銷了符合預期的7月消費者通膨數據所帶來的影響。最新通膨數據降低了市場對聯準會(Fed)升息的預期。
近期投資人提高對貨幣政策收緊的預期，帶動美元走強，但最新通膨數據並未出現足以延續這波漲勢的意外升幅。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.2%，報99.98。CPI數據早上公布後，美元指數一度擴大跌幅，觸及99.61盤中低點，之後回升並在中午前轉為走高。
外匯市場參與者周三將焦點集中在7月消費者物價指數(CPI)報告，以尋找更多貨幣政策前景的線索。上周五公布的7月就業報告弱於預期，導致市場迅速重新調整對聯準會9月升息的預期。
根據美國勞工統計局數據，7月整體CPI月增0.1%，6月則下跌0.4%。年增率則從6月的3.5%放緩至3.4%。扣除食品及能源價格的核心CPI，7月月增0.2%，6月則持平。年增率也從2.6%放緩至2.5%。上述4項數據均符合市場預期。
周四將接著公布7月生產者物價指數(PPI)。雖然CPI與PPI都是市場廣泛關注的通膨指標，但聯準會更偏好追蹤個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數，以評估通膨情勢。CPI與PPI中的部分項目會被納入PCE的計算。
對聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)而言，這些符合預期的數據可能讓其有更多空間維持利率不變，而不是升息，尤其是在周五公布疲弱就業報告之後。
利率市場也反映出這項預期。CME FedWatch工具顯示，CPI公布後，市場預期9月維持利率不變的機率從54%升至62%。
荷姆茲海峽緊張持續 布油徘徊90美元
目光轉向中東，油價周三震盪，市場持續受到各方對荷姆茲海峽(Strait of Hormuz)不同說法的影響。布蘭特原油(Brent)期貨一度短暫觸及每桶90美元。
目前看來，重新開放這條重要水道的和平協議進展有限，美國與伊朗仍持續宣稱掌握這條重要航道的控制權。
美國總統川普在Truth Social上表示，「美國完全控制荷姆茲海峽。」
伊朗國營媒體周二稍早報導，伊朗再次提出要求，表示美國必須停止各條戰線上的敵對行動，並解凍遭凍結的資產，荷姆茲海峽才會重新開放。相關說法引述伊朗國家安全委員會主席Mohsen Rezaei向中國駐德黑蘭大使發表的言論。
據伊朗國營媒體，Rezaei表示，「在美國改變行為並接受伊朗的條件之前，荷姆茲海峽不會開放。任何伊朗與阿曼之間的航運協議，都是獨立於荷姆茲海峽關閉之外的另一件事。」
Kpler數據顯示，周二獲確認通過荷姆茲海峽的船隻數量小幅增加，但整體市場氣氛仍保持謹慎，加上新的攻擊事件進一步加劇擔憂。
葉門叛軍「青年運動」(Houthi)在曼德海峽(Mandeb Strait)攻擊商業航運，造成4名貨輪船員及2名葉門救援人員死亡。
日元持續回吐干預後漲幅
其他主要貨幣方面，日元兌美元走弱，持續回吐上月底華盛頓與東京進行歷史性聯合干預後取得漲幅。美元兌日元上漲0.1%，至159.46。
稍早公布的最新Reuters Tankan調查顯示，受強勁半導體需求及國內消費旺盛帶動，日本企業信心在8月有所改善。這項調查旨在提前反映日本央行(BoJ)季度企業短期經濟觀測調查的結果。

items.title: 日元兩周內吐回干預漲幅一半 為何美日干預仍難解基本面壓力？
items.title_en: Why Is It Still Hard for US‑Japan Intervention to Overcome Fundamental Pressure Even After the Yen Gives Back Half of Its Gains in Two Weeks?
paras: 自美日兩國進行歷史性匯市干預帶動日元反彈至今，才短短不到兩周，日元漲幅已經回吐約一半，凸顯基本面力量愈來愈難以透過短期措施扭轉的現況。
日元目前回落到1美元兌159日元以上。在美日干預前，日元一度貶破163，干預過後最高曾升到155。
Monex集團專家董事Jesper Koll說：「干預已經嚇到市場，但並沒有阻止金融市場的規律，也就是資金會流向報酬率最高的地方……只要日本資金成本低於海外報酬率，套利交易就會重新出現。」

日元升值空間受制於美日報酬率差

根本原因在於日本與美國之間的報酬率差距。日本借貸成本仍遠低於美國及其他市場，促使投資人以低成本借入日元，再投入高收益資產，形成典型的日元套利交易(carry trade，也稱利差交易)。
目前的大環境也不利日元，美國公債殖利率走升，有利於美元，再加上油價維持在高檔，對日本這種高度仰賴能源進口的國家尤其不利。
Koll認為，干預確實成功讓投機交易不至於過度升溫，也提高放空日元交易者所承擔的風險，但並未消除支撐美元那個最基本的殖利率優勢。
State Street Global Advisors資深固定收益與外匯策略師Masahiko Loo說：「干預成功的重塑市場心理，也展現美日兩國政策協調罕見的強度。但目前還沒有消除支撐美元的殖利率優勢。」
美日殖利率差距仍然明顯：基準的10年期美國公債殖利率目前為4.686%，日本10年期公債殖利率則為2.846%，這代表投資人持有美國公債仍享有可觀的報酬誘因。
Loo說：「與其說這是成功改變基本面，不如說是成功放緩投機交易。」
目前市場把目光聚焦在日本銀行(BOJ，央行)，和預定9月召開的下一次貨幣決策會議。
Koll表示，對投資人而言，更大的衝擊並非匯市干預本身，而是日銀不願更積極收緊貨幣政策。這也讓外界質疑，決策者的行動空間是否被銀行體系問題或日本龐大的公共債務負擔限縮住了。
在日本利率沒有進一步走高、或者美國殖利率沒有下滑的情況下，投資人仍有誘因將資金投入海外市場。
Lombard Odier亞洲區投資長John Wood表示，最新一輪干預可能只帶來「有限的時間效果」，他認為日銀可能至少還需要升息兩次，才能遏制日元持續走弱的趨勢。

日元面臨多重逆風

不過，利率可能只是其中一部分原因。法國東方匯理銀行(Crédit Agricole CIB)指出，更深層的問題在於美日兩國之間的「投資力量不對稱」：美國對人工智慧(AI)及其他領域的大規模投資，持續吸引全球資金流入，但日本首相高市早苗規劃的公私部門投資計畫，目前仍尚未完全實現。
該銀行表示：「要修正日元疲弱的問題，需要的不是升息，而是擴大投資。」
這代表日元若要出現可持續的升值行情，最終仍需讓日本本身的資產變得更具吸引力，鼓勵日本國內儲蓄留在國內，而不是追逐海外報酬。
現階段來看，匯市干預的作用與其說是扭轉日元貶勢，不如說是避免日元加速貶值。

160日元成政治紅線

State Street的Loo表示，160日元已成為「政治上的紅線」，如果日元再次快速貶破這一關卡，可能促使當局再次進場干預。
Loo說：「我不排除再次干預的可能性，尤其是如果日元走勢加快或失序。但最終而言，干預只能爭取時間，真正需要發揮作用的仍是日銀貨幣政策正常化，最快可能從9月開始。」
華府與東京也試圖透過強調聯準會(Fed)提供的「外國及國際貨幣當局附買回機制」(FIMA Repo Facility)，進一步強化干預的威力。該機制能讓日本以美國公債作為擔保取得美元流動性，降低日本為籌措干預資金而出售美國公債的需求。
美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)已表示支持擴大這項金融安全網。這可能提高押注日元貶值的成本，但並不代表背後的套利交易邏輯會因此消失。
Koll表示：「嚇阻市場很容易，但要讓市場跟著政策走，需要改變誘因，也需要信任。」
paras_en: Since the historic currency‑market intervention by the United States and Japan sparked a rebound in the yen, in less than two weeks the yen has already given back about half of its rise, highlighting how increasingly difficult it is for short‑term measures to reverse the underlying fundamentals.
The yen has now slipped back to above ¥159 per US$1. Before the intervention, the yen had fallen past ¥163, and after the intervention it briefly rose as high as ¥155.

Jesper Koll, expert director at Monex Group, said: “The intervention scared the market, but it did not stop the natural law of financial markets, which is that capital flows to the highest‑returning places… As long as Japanese funding costs are lower than overseas returns, arbitrage trades will re‑emerge.”

The yen’s upside is constrained by the US‑Japan yield gap. The root cause is the yield differential between Japan and the United States. Japan’s borrowing costs remain far below those in the US and other markets, prompting investors to borrow yen cheaply and invest in higher‑yielding assets, creating the classic yen carry trade.
The broader environment also hurts the yen: rising US Treasury yields support the dollar, and high oil prices are especially detrimental to Japan, which relies heavily on energy imports.

Koll believes the intervention succeeded in preventing speculative trades from overheating and increased the risk for those shorting the yen, but it did not eliminate the fundamental yield advantage that underpins the dollar.

Masahiko Loo, senior fixed‑income and FX strategist at State Street Global Advisors, said: “The intervention successfully reshaped market psychology and demonstrated an unusually strong coordination between US and Japanese policies. Yet it has not removed the yield advantage that supports the dollar.”

The US‑Japan yield gap remains stark: the benchmark 10‑year US Treasury yield is about 4.686%, while Japan’s 10‑year yield is roughly 2.846%, meaning investors still enjoy a sizable return incentive from holding US bonds.
Loo added: “Rather than saying this changed the fundamentals, it’s more accurate to say it slowed speculative trading.”
Market attention is now focused on the Bank of Japan and the next monetary policy meeting scheduled for September.

Koll noted that for investors the bigger shock is not the FX intervention itself but the BOJ’s reluctance to tighten policy more aggressively. This raises doubts whether policymakers’ room for action is constrained by banking‑system issues or Japan’s massive public‑debt burden.
Without higher Japanese rates or lower US yields, investors still have an incentive to allocate capital to overseas markets.

John Wood, head of Asian investments at Lombard Odier, said the latest round of intervention may only provide a “limited‑time effect” and that the BOJ likely needs at least two more rate hikes to curb the yen’s continued weakness.

The yen faces multiple headwinds. However, rates may be only part of the story. Crédit Agricole CIB pointed out a deeper issue: an “asymmetric investment power” between the US and Japan, with massive US spending on AI and other sectors drawing global capital, while Prime Minister Kishida’s public‑private investment plan remains only partially implemented.
The bank said: “Fixing the yen’s weakness requires not rate hikes but expanding investment.”
That means for the yen to achieve a sustainable appreciation, Japan’s own assets must become more attractive, encouraging domestic savings to stay at home rather than chase overseas returns.
At this stage, the role of FX intervention is less about reversing yen depreciation and more about preventing an accelerated decline.
¥160 has become a political red line. State Street’s Loo said ¥160 is now a “political red line”; a rapid breach could prompt authorities to intervene again.

Loo added: “I don’t rule out another intervention, especially if the yen’s move speeds up or becomes disorderly. Ultimately, intervention only buys time; the real driver must be BOJ policy normalization, which could start as early as September.”

Washington and Tokyo are also trying to boost the impact of intervention by emphasizing the Fed’s Foreign and International Monetary Authorities Repo (FIMA) facility, which lets Japan obtain dollar liquidity using US Treasuries as collateral, reducing the need to sell US bonds to fund intervention.

US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has voiced support for expanding this financial safety net. It may raise the cost of betting on yen depreciation, but it does not eliminate the underlying arbitrage logic.
Koll concluded: “Deterring the market is easy, but getting the market to follow policy requires changing incentives and building trust.”

items.title: USD/JPY：美元逐步逼近160日圓，市場對干預的期待降溫，CPI數據即將公佈
items.title_en: USD/JPY: US Dollar Edges Closer to 160 Yen, Market Expectations for Intervention Cool Down, CPI Data to Be Released
paras: 要點：

美元兌日圓升向160日圓
市場對干預的擔憂降溫
CPI報告即將公佈


東京與華盛頓曾將美元兌日圓從164日圓打壓至155日圓。但僅僅一週後，美元多頭已經開始重新靠近這個危險區域。
歷史性干預措施逐漸失去效力

週三，USDJPY升至約159.44日圓，逼近心理關卡160日圓。
在東京與華盛頓聯手將匯價從接近40年高點的164日圓拉回至155日圓後，日圓已回吐近一半由干預措施帶動的漲幅。
這次干預作為短期衝擊的效果相當驚人，但要扭轉長期趨勢，效果就沒那麼明顯了。
當局拋售外幣、買進日圓，迫使看空日圓的部位平倉。當這波軋空行情結束後，美日利差又悄悄恢復主導地位。
日本利率仍遠低於美國，持續鼓勵套利交易：借入低利率的日圓，再買進收益率較高的美元資產。
只要這樣的報酬仍具吸引力，交易員就有動機重新建立日圓空頭部位 — 即使當局已展現出對此高度不滿，而且干預成本十分高昂。


美國通膨將成為下一個關鍵

週三將公佈7月CPI，經濟學家預期整體CPI月增0.1%、年增3.4%。剔除波動較大的食品與能源價格後，核心CPI預估月增0.2%、年增2.5%。
如果通膨數據高於預期，尤其核心CPI達到0.3%或更高，可能強化市場對聯準會9月升息的預期。美國殖利率上升將提高美元資產的吸引力，可能推動美元/日圓突破160日圓。
若通膨降溫，則可能支持聯準會暫停升息，壓低美債殖利率，並讓日圓獲得喘息空間。7月就業人數減少23,000人，已經是不利於進一步緊縮政策的訊號。


160日圓將成為政策可信度的關卡

從技術面來看，160日圓不只是一般的阻力位，更像是一條政策警戒線。如果匯價明確突破，可能重新上看163.70–164日圓；但漲勢越快，再次遭到干預的風險也越高。美元多頭可能看對方向，卻仍可能因當局出手的時機而遭到重創。
初步下方支撐位落在158和157日圓附近，其後則是干預後的155日圓區域。如果跌破這一水準，將顯示當局的干預可能已經產生較持久的效果。
干預並非完全沒有效果；它確實會改變市場部位、波動率，以及做空日圓的成本。但如果美日利差沒有縮小，這就像是把沙灘球壓進水裡。現在，CPI將決定這顆球能否繼續被壓在水下 — 還是再次狠狠彈回160日圓。
